title: Anaesthetic Techniques for Cardiac Ablation-A Scoping Review
summary: Background Cardiac arrhythmias, particularly atrial fibrillation, have rising prevalence and represent a growing global health burden. Catheter ablation is a commonly used treatment demanding sedation or anaesthesia for comfort, stability and safety. Anaesthetic techniques vary globally, and the optimal strategy has yet to be determined. The objective of this scoping review was to map the current literature on anaesthesia for catheter ablation, identifying how it has been investigated and which evidence gaps exist.Methods This scoping review followed a pre-published protocol and guidelines. A search was conducted in MEDLINE, EMBASE, Cochrane, Google Scholar, and Scopus, with no restrictions on publication year or language. Eligible studies were primary studies involving adult patients undergoing catheter ablation in hospitals, clinics, or similar healthcare facilities.Results We included 110 studies published between 1991 and 2025. The reported anaesthetic techniques included General Anaesthesia (GA), Deep Sedation (DS), Conscious Sedation (CS), Minimal Sedation, and Local Anaesthesia (LA). Complications were infrequently reported, recovery was comparable, and patient and operator satisfaction was high across techniques. Techniques varied across regions, with GA being most frequent in North America, GA and CS in Asia, and DS in Europe. Anaesthesia quality was commonly assessed by intraprocedural respiratory and haemodynamic stability and complication rates, whilst anaesthesia effectiveness was mostly assessed using procedure duration, accumulated medication, sedation depth, and sedation failure/escalation.Conclusion This scoping review mapped current anaesthetic practices in catheter ablations. GA, DS, and CS were most frequently reported. Complications were infrequent and satisfaction high. However, evidence gaps and inconsistent definitions and assessment methods highlight the need for future research and standardisation.Editorial comment Electrophysiological cardiac interventions such as catheter ablations commonly now also involve anaesthesiological management. This scoping review presents an update on knowledge for how this care may facilitate good procedural results.

AI.tldr: 这项纳入110项研究的范围综述显示，导管消融的麻醉以全麻、深度镇静和清醒镇静为主，各技术并发症少见且满意度高；但定义与评估方法不统一，最优策略仍未确定。
AI.motivation: 心律失常尤其是心房颤动的患病率持续上升，已成为全球性健康负担。导管消融是常用治疗手段，为保证患者舒适、导管稳定与操作安全，需要镇静或麻醉支持。然而各国麻醉策略差异明显，何种方案最优尚无定论；既往文献也未被系统梳理，不清楚相关研究采用了哪些设计，以及存在哪些证据缺口。因此有必要通过范围综述描绘现有证据图景。
AI.method: 范围综述，遵循预先注册发布的方案与相关指南。检索 MEDLINE、EMBASE、Cochrane、Google Scholar 与 Scopus，不限制发表年份与语言。纳入标准为在院、门诊或类似医疗机构接受导管消融的成人患者的原始研究。最终纳入1991—2025年间发表的110项研究。麻醉质量主要以术中呼吸与血流动力学稳定性及并发症率评估；麻醉有效性主要以手术时长、累计用药量、镇静深度以及镇静失败或升级情况评估。摘要未报告具体的偏倚评价与统计合并方法。
AI.result: 共纳入110项研究。报告的麻醉方式包括全身麻醉（GA）、深度镇静（DS）、清醒镇静（CS）、最小镇静与局部麻醉（LA）。并发症报告少见，各技术间恢复情况相当，患者与术者满意度均较高。麻醉方式存在地区差异：北美以 GA 最常见，亚洲以 GA 与 CS 为主，欧洲以 DS 为主。各研究对麻醉质量与有效性的定义及评估指标不一致。摘要未报告定量效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值。
AI.conclusion: 现有文献中，GA、DS 与 CS 是导管消融最常报告的麻醉方式；并发症少见、满意度高，提示多种方案均可在电生理手术中安全实施。但研究间麻醉方式定义与结局评估方法高度异质，且缺乏以硬终点比较不同策略的证据，故无法推荐最优麻醉方案。该综述为房颤消融围术期麻醉管理提供了现状基线，提示未来需开展标准化定义的前瞻性对照研究。局限性在于：范围综述不提供疗效比较或定量合并；本摘要未报告方法学质量评价结果，地区分布差异亦可能受发表偏倚影响。

title: Efficacy of catheter ablation for arrhythmia in adults with congenital heart disease: A meta-analysis of clinical outcomes.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Arrhythmias remain a major clinical challenge in adult congenital heart disease (aCHD), contributing significantly to increased hospitalization rates and cardiac complications, affecting over 50% of aCHD patients. Catheter ablation (CA) is regarded as a first-line therapeutic modality due to its potential for disease modification. However, concerns persist regarding its long-term efficacy and safety. Thus, a comprehensive evaluation of CA outcomes in this population is warranted.

METHODS: The outcomes of interest were the success rate, secondary ablation rate, complication rates, and recurrence of arrhythmias. Quality assessment was done using the Risk of Bias in Non-randomized Studies of Interventions tool, and meta-analysis was performed using RStudio.

RESULTS: A comprehensive search of seven databases yielded 15 articles for analysis, among which 10 were categorized as low-risk, four as moderate-risk, and one lacked information regarding bias. The single-arm meta-analysis, examining events per 100 observations, revealed a success rate of 85.37 (95% confidence interval [CI] =78.50, 92.24). Moreover, the secondary ablation rate was determined to be 29.29 (95% CI = 16.92, 41.66), while major complications occurred at a rate of 2.81 (95% CI = 0.89, 4.73) and minor complications at a rate of 5.29 (95% CI = 1.88, 8.70). The overall recurrence rate of arrhythmias was found to be 40.33 (95% CI = 28.37, 52.29), with specific rates for intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia at 20.33 (95% CI = 11.24, 29.43), atrial fibrillation at 14.25 (95% CI = 3.46, 25.05), and atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia at 9.70 (95% CI = 0.00, 19.56). Lastly, the implantation rate of implantable cardioverter defibrilators (ICDs) was found to be 1.05 (95% CI = 0.12, 1.99).

CONCLUSION: CA for arrhythmias in aCHD patients demonstrates high success rates with minimal procedural complications. However, the substantial recurrence rates highlight the need for ongoing monitoring and proactive strategies to optimize long-term outcomes.

AI.tldr: 纳入15项研究的单臂荟萃分析显示，成人先天性心脏病（aCHD）患者心律失常导管消融成功率约85.37/100例，主要并发症仅2.81/100例，但总体复发率高达40.33/100例。
AI.motivation: 心律失常是成人先天性心脏病（aCHD）的主要临床难题，影响超过50%的患者，显著增加住院率与心脏并发症。导管消融因可能改变疾病进程而被视为一线治疗手段，但其长期疗效与安全性仍存争议，既往缺乏对该人群消融结局的系统汇总证据，因此有必要进行全面评估。
AI.method: 系统评价与单臂荟萃分析。检索7个数据库，最终纳入15篇文献；采用ROBINS-I工具进行偏倚风险质量评价（10项低风险、4项中等风险、1项信息不足），使用RStudio完成统计分析。关注终点为消融成功率、二次消融率、并发症发生率（主要/次要）、心律失常复发率（总体及心房内折返性心动过速IART、心房颤动AF、房室结折返性心动过速AVNRT分型）以及ICD植入率；效应量以每100例观察的事件数表示。纳入患者总样本量摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 在aCHD人群中，心律失常导管消融成功率高、围术期并发症发生率低，支持其作为该人群的可行治疗选择；但复发率与二次消融率仍较高，提示需长期随访监测并采取更积极的策略（如优化基质标测与消融范围、个体化选择再次消融时机）以改善远期结局。局限性：纳入研究均为单臂设计、以观察性数据为主，缺乏对照与统一的终点定义，异质性信息与总样本量摘要未报告，结论的稳健性有待前瞻性对照研究验证。

title: Generative recurrence analysis and metric learning for detection of atrial fibrillation from short ECG data.
summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals exhibit complex, nonlinear, and nonstationary dynamics that are not fully captured by conventional time series analysis methods. In this study, we propose a novel framework for atrial fibrillation (AF) detection that integrates a beat-level recurrence representation with supervised metric learning. ECG recordings are first segmented into beat-centered waveforms that serve as effective dynamical states, avoiding the inaccurate estimation of time delay and embedding dimension from short recordings. Rather than constructing conventional recurrence plots from delay-embedded trajectories, the proposed method forms a beat-to-beat dissimilarity matrix using the Jensen-Shannon distance between normalized ECG beat segments. This representation captures variations in beat morphology and rhythm irregularity and provides information complementary to heart rate variability descriptors and recurrence quantification features. A contrastive Gaussian-mixture variational autoencoder learns an eight-component latent distribution with two components assigned to each of the four rhythm classes. Reconstruction, Gaussian-mixture regularization, supervised classification, clustering, and contrastive objectives jointly promote informative, compact, and class-discriminative latent representations. Class-conditional samples drawn from the learned mixture provide balanced synthetic latent representations for classifier training. Evaluated on the four-class PhysioNet/CinC 2017 dataset, the proposed framework achieves an overall accuracy of approximately 94%, with F1 scores of 0.97, 0.95, 0.92, and 0.86 for normal sinus rhythm, AF, other rhythm, and noise, respectively. These results demonstrate the potential of combining beat-level nonlinear dynamics, structured generative modeling, and metric learning for AF detection from short ECG recordings.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出融合心搏层面复发表示与监督度量学习的生成式框架，在 PhysioNet/CinC 2017 四分类短 ECG 数据上检测 AF，总体准确率约 94%，AF 类 F1 达 0.95。
AI.motivation: 常规时间序列分析方法难以充分刻画 ECG 的复杂、非线性、非平稳动力学；并且在短记录中，时延与嵌入维数的估计不准确，使得传统基于相空间重构的复发图分析受限。研究旨在构建一种不依赖时延嵌入、可在短 ECG 上稳定识别 AF 的检测框架，并弥补心率变异性与复发量化特征所提供信息的不足。
AI.method: 方法学研究（算法开发与回顾性数据集验证）。以心搏为中心对 ECG 分段，将每个心搏波形视为动力学状态，用归一化心搏段之间的 Jensen-Shannon 距离构建心搏间差异矩阵以替代传统复发图；采用对比式高斯混合变分自编码器学习 8 分量隐分布（4 个节律类别各占 2 个分量），联合重构、高斯混合正则、监督分类、聚类与对比目标训练，并从学到的混合分布中抽取类别条件样本生成平衡的合成隐表示以供分类器训练。评估数据集为 PhysioNet/CinC 2017 四分类（正常窦性心律、AF、其他心律、噪声），样本量与统计检验方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 在 PhysioNet/CinC 2017 四分类数据上总体准确率约 94%；各类 F1 分别为正常窦性心律 0.97、AF 0.95、其他心律 0.92、噪声 0.86。摘要未报告 95% 置信区间、P 值，也未报告灵敏度、特异度及受试者工作特征曲线下面积等指标。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将心搏层面非线性动力学、结构化生成建模与度量学习相结合，可用于短 ECG 记录的 AF 检测，并避免短记录中时延与嵌入维数估计误差的问题。其临床意义在于为可穿戴设备与短时程筛查场景提供潜在算法基础；局限性包括：摘要未报告样本量、外部验证与前瞻性数据，噪声类 F1（0.86）相对偏低，且缺乏与常规复发量化或心率变异性方法的头对头比较数据，尚需在真实临床人群中进一步验证。

title: Association of Iron Homeostasis With One‐Year All‐Cause Mortality Among Intensive Care Unit Patients with Atrial Fibrillation: A Retrospective Study
summary: Background Perturbations in iron homeostasis can substantially affect cardiovascular outcomes. This study aims to evaluate the prognostic value of various iron homeostasis indicators for all-cause mortality in critically ill AF patients.Method Data for this retrospective study were obtained from the Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV database. Based on the iron homeostasis-related indicators (ferritin, serum iron, transferrin, and total iron-binding capacity [TIBC]), the risks of 1-year mortality among critically ill patients with atrial fibrillation were calculated using Cox proportional-hazards regression. Associations of iron homeostasis indicators with all-cause mortality in critically ill AF patients were assessed via Kaplan-Meier curves, restricted cubic splines, and subgroup analyses.Results After multivariable adjustment, patients in the highest ferritin quartile had a greater risk of 1-year mortality than those in the lowest quartile (Q4 HR 1.277, 95% CI 1.083-1.506, p < 0.01). In contrast, the highest quartiles of transferrin (Q4 HR 0.732, 95% CI 0.622-0.861, p < 0.01) and TIBC (Q4 HR 0.732, 95% CI 0.622-0.861, p < 0.01) were associated with lower mortality. No significant association was observed between serum iron quartiles and 1-year mortality (Q4 HR 1.067, 95% CI 0.914-1.245, p = 0.41). Restricted cubic spline analyses further characterized the exposure and outcome patterns for these iron-related parameters.Conclusion Among critically ill patients with AF, ferritin, transferrin and TIBC levels were independently associated with 1-year all-cause mortality. No significant association was observed for serum iron.

AI.tldr: 在 MIMIC-IV 的危重房颤患者中，铁蛋白升高与 1 年全因死亡风险增加独立相关，而转铁蛋白和总铁结合力（TIBC）升高则与死亡风险降低相关，血清铁则无显著关联。
AI.motivation: 铁稳态紊乱可影响心血管结局，但既往证据多来自一般人群或慢性心衰人群，对重症监护病房（ICU）内房颤（AF）患者这一高危群体的预后价值尚不明确。研究旨在评估多种铁稳态指标对危重 AF 患者全因死亡的预测价值，为风险分层寻找易得的实验室标志物。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，数据取自 MIMIC-IV 数据库。研究对象为 ICU 危重 AF 患者，样本量摘要未报告。暴露指标为铁稳态相关指标（铁蛋白、血清铁、转铁蛋白、总铁结合力 TIBC），按四分位数分组，以最低分位为参照。主要终点为 1 年全因死亡。采用 Cox 比例风险回归进行多因素校正并估计 HR 与 95%CI，辅以 Kaplan-Meier 曲线、限制性立方样条（RCS）刻画剂量-反应关系，并行亚组分析。
AI.result: 多因素校正后，铁蛋白最高四分位组（Q4）1 年死亡风险高于最低分位组（HR 1.277，95%CI 1.083–1.506，p<0.01）。转铁蛋白 Q4（HR 0.732，95%CI 0.622–0.861，p<0.01）与 TIBC Q4（HR 0.732，95%CI 0.622–0.861，p<0.01）均与较低死亡风险相关；需注意摘要中转铁蛋白与 TIBC 的效应量与置信区间数值完全一致，疑为原文报告重复。血清铁各分位与 1 年死亡无显著关联（Q4 HR 1.067，95%CI 0.914–1.245，p=0.41）。限制性立方样条进一步描述了上述指标与结局的暴露-反应曲线形态，但摘要未报告具体节点数值或非线性检验 P 值；Kaplan-Meier 与亚组分析的具体结果摘要亦未报告。
AI.conclusion: 在危重 AF 患者中，铁蛋白、转铁蛋白与 TIBC 水平与 1 年全因死亡独立相关，血清铁则无显著关联，提示入院早期铁代谢谱可作为 ICU 房颤患者风险分层的辅助工具。局限性包括：回顾性单库设计、样本量未在摘要中报告、仅提示关联而非因果、未涉及铁剂补充等干预信息，且转铁蛋白与 TIBC 结果数值重复需核对原始数据；对电生理实践而言，该指标尚不能指导抗凝或节律干预决策，需前瞻性队列验证。

title: Antithrombotic Therapy in Patients with Chronic Coronary Disease on Anticoagulation: Evidence from Contemporary Trials.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Chronic coronary disease (CCD) commonly coexists with long-term oral anticoagulation (OAC), particularly for atrial fibrillation (AF). Combination antiplatelet therapy increases bleeding, whereas ischemic protection with OAC alone remains a concern. We critically appraised contemporary evidence and guidelines to define optimal long-term maintenance therapy.

METHODS: We synthesized WOEST, PIONEER AF-PCI, RE-DUAL PCI, AUGUSTUS, AFIRE, OAC-ALONE, PRAEDO-AF, EPIC-CAD, AQUATIC, and meta-analyses. Because foundational trials included recent ACS/PCI populations, evidence was analyzed as early/recent ACS or PCI (≤1 year) and late/stable CAD (>1 year post-PCI or non-revascularized CCD). Designs, populations, ischemic, bleeding, and mortality outcomes were systematically compared within the 2023 ACC/AHA CCD and AF guidelines.

RESULTS AND DISCUSSION: Early trials supported aspirin withdrawal and DOAC plus single P2Y12 inhibition after PCI. Later trials showed full-dose OAC monotherapy was noninferior to OAC plus single antiplatelet therapy beyond 6-12 months or in stable non-revascularized CCD for preventing myocardial infarction, stroke, and systemic embolism, while reducing major and clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding and, sometimes, mortality. Meta-analysis showed fewer cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, stroke, and major bleeding events without excess ischemia.

CONCLUSION: OAC monotherapy should be the default for most patients, reserving antiplatelets for individualized high-ischemic/low-bleeding-risk scenarios, while recognizing predominantly East Asian and limited European evidence.

AI.tldr: 本综述整合 WOEST 至 EPIC-CAD 等试验，提示房颤合并慢性冠心病患者的长期抗栓治疗应以全剂量口服抗凝药单药为默认策略，仅在个体化高缺血、低出血风险情形下保留抗血小板药物；证据以东亚人群为主。
AI.motivation: 慢性冠心病（CCD）与长期口服抗凝（OAC）并存的情况非常普遍，尤其是合并房颤（AF）者。既往临床困境在于：加用抗血小板药物会显著增加出血风险，而单用 OAC 能否提供足够的缺血保护长期存疑。已有基础性试验多纳入近期急性冠脉综合征（ACS）或 PCI 围术期人群，无法直接回答 PCI 后 1 年以上或未行血运重建的稳定期 CCD 患者应如何长期维持抗栓治疗，指南推荐亦存在空白与分歧，因此有必要系统梳理当代证据。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性证据综述与指南对照分析，未开展新的原始研究。作者整合了 WOEST、PIONEER AF-PCI、RE-DUAL PCI、AUGUSTUS、AFIRE、OAC-ALONE、PRAEDO-AF、EPIC-CAD、AQUATIC 等随机对照试验及相关荟萃分析。由于基础性试验主要纳入近期 ACS/PCI 人群，作者按两个时段分层分析：早期/近期 ACS 或 PCI（≤1 年）与晚期/稳定 CAD（PCI 后 >1 年或未行血运重建的 CCD）。系统比较各研究的设计、研究人群以及缺血终点、出血终点与死亡终点，并将其置于 2023 ACC/AHA 的 CCD 与 AF 指南框架下进行评判。各研究的具体样本量摘要未报告。
AI.result: 早期试验支持 PCI 术后停用阿司匹林，改为 DOAC 联合单一 P2Y12 受体抑制剂的双联方案。后期试验显示，在 PCI 后 6–12 个月以上或稳定未血运重建的 CCD 患者中，全剂量 OAC 单药在预防心肌梗死、卒中及体循环栓塞方面不劣于 OAC 联合单一抗血小板治疗，同时减少大出血与临床相关非大出血，部分研究还观察到死亡率下降。荟萃分析显示，OAC 单药可减少心血管死亡、心肌梗死、卒中及大出血事件，且未增加缺血事件。各终点具体效应量与 95% 置信区间、P 值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 对于多数房颤合并慢性冠心病、且已度过 PCI 术后早期阶段的患者，全剂量 OAC 单药应作为默认的长期维持抗栓策略，抗血小板药物仅保留给经个体化评估属高缺血风险、低出血风险的特定情形。这一策略可在不牺牲缺血保护的前提下降低出血负担，对电生理与房颤综合管理中的长期抗栓决策具有直接影响。局限在于：支持性证据主要来自东亚人群，欧洲数据有限，人群外推性受限；本文为证据综述而非新的头对头试验，且未提供量化合并效应，仍需在更多地区和人群中验证。

title: Longitudinal Left Atrial Remodeling With Pharmacological Rhythm Versus Rate Control in Paroxysmal and Persistent Atrial Fibrillation
summary: Purpose Evidence regarding left atrial (LA) remodeling with pharmacological rhythm control remains limited, particularly in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) outside heart-failure-specific populations.Methods This single-center retrospective cohort included 156 adults with paroxysmal or persistent AF receiving mutually exclusive pharmacological rate-control (n = 92) or rhythm-control (n = 64) therapy who underwent two transthoracic echocardiograms. LA remodeling was assessed using serial echocardiography, and clinical outcomes were evaluated after the second examination.Results Among 74 patients with paired left atrial volume index (LAVI) measurements, LAVI increased from 39.9 to 50.3 mL/m2 with rate control (p < 0.001) but remained unchanged with rhythm control (44.9 to 43.4 mL/m2; p = 0.465). After adjustment for baseline LAVI and clinical covariates, rhythm control was associated with a 9.38 mL/m2 lower follow-up LAVI (95% CI, -15.53 to -3.24; p = 0.003). The association with lower follow-up LAVI was also observed among patients without heart failure and remained similar in sensitivity analyses. During post-landmark follow-up, rhythm control was associated with a lower hazard of all-cause mortality or stroke hospitalization (adjusted HR, 0.46; 95% CI, 0.24-0.88; p = 0.019).Conclusion Pharmacological rhythm control was associated with more favorable longitudinal LA remodeling than rate control, including among patients without heart failure, and was also associated with a lower hazard of subsequent all-cause mortality or stroke hospitalization.

AI.tldr: 在阵发性或持续性房颤患者中，药物节律控制相比室率控制与更有利的左房纵向重构相关：校正后随访期左房容积指数（LAVI）低9.38 mL/m2，且全因死亡或卒中住院风险更低。
AI.motivation: 关于药物节律控制对左房重构影响的认识仍有限，既往证据多来自以心力衰竭为核心的人群，缺乏针对普通房颤人群、以系列超声心动图评估左房结构重塑的研究，临床上难以判断节律控制是否能在室率控制之外带来结构层面的获益。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入156例接受两次经胸超声心动图检查的阵发性或持续性房颤成人患者，按治疗分为互斥的药物室率控制组（n=92）与节律控制组（n=64）。以系列超声心动图测量的左房容积指数（LAVI）为主要重构指标，第二次超声后评估临床结局；采用多因素回归校正基线LAVI及临床协变量，并以Landmark分析后的随访评估全因死亡或卒中住院风险，另行敏感性分析。摘要未报告随访时长、两次超声间隔、具体药物种类及校正变量清单。
AI.result: 共74例具备配对LAVI测量：室率控制组LAVI由39.9升至50.3 mL/m2（p<0.001），节律控制组无显著变化（44.9→43.4 mL/m2；p=0.465）。校正基线LAVI及临床协变量后，节律控制与随访期LAVI低9.38 mL/m2相关（95%CI -15.53～-3.24；p=0.003）；在无心力衰竭患者中该关联同样存在，敏感性分析结果相似。Landmark时点后随访中，节律控制与全因死亡或卒中住院复合终点风险更低相关（校正HR 0.46；95%CI 0.24～0.88；p=0.019）。
AI.conclusion: 药物节律控制较室率控制与更有利的左房纵向重构相关，在无心力衰竭患者中亦然，并伴随全因死亡或卒中住院风险降低。提示在房颤综合管理中，节律控制可能具有延缓左房结构重构的额外价值。但本研究为单中心回顾性设计、样本量有限，节律控制组基线LAVI偏高，存在选择偏倚与残余混杂可能，且随访时长与用药方案未在摘要中报告，结论需前瞻性随机研究进一步验证。

title: Digitoxin in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction according to atrial fibrillation status: the DIGIT-HF trial
Transient sinus arrest caused by coronary spasm of the sinus node artery after pulsed field ablation for superior vena cava isolation: a case report.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) has emerged as a novel non-thermal ablation modality with preferential myocardial selectivity. However, its effects on adjacent structures, including the sinus node and its arterial supply, remain incompletely understood.

CASE SUMMARY: A 72-year-old woman underwent repeat ablation for recurrent paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Following pulmonary vein isolation, superior vena cava (SVC) isolation was performed using a PFA system. Sinus rhythm was initially preserved. However, sinus arrest developed several minutes after ablation. High right atrial backup pacing was initiated. Coronary angiography revealed severe spasm of the sinus node artery. Sinus node function gradually recovered after supportive management. Post-procedural voltage mapping confirmed successful SVC isolation.

DISCUSSION: This case highlights delayed sinus arrest following SVC isolation using PFA, with angiographic evidence suggesting sinus node artery spasm. While multiple mechanisms may contribute to sinus node dysfunction after PFA, coronary vasospasm should be considered, particularly in cases with delayed onset.

AI.tldr: 72岁女性复发阵发性房颤患者在PFA上腔静脉隔离后数分钟出现迟发窦性停搏，冠脉造影证实窦房结动脉严重痉挛，经支持治疗后窦房结功能逐渐恢复。
AI.motivation: 脉冲场消融（PFA）作为非热消融方式，具有心肌选择性优势，已被用于肺静脉隔离及上腔静脉（SVC）隔离；但其对邻近结构（包括窦房结及其动脉血供）的影响尚不明确，既往证据多为机制推测，缺乏术中造影直接证据，临床上对PFA术后迟发窦性停搏的识别与处理经验有限。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。对象为72岁女性，因复发性阵发性心房颤动接受再次消融：先行肺静脉隔离，随后使用PFA系统行上腔静脉隔离。观察指标包括术中及术后心律监测、窦性停搏出现后的冠脉造影，以及术后三维电解剖电压标测确认SVC隔离是否成功；摘要未报告用药方案、时间参数及随访时长，未涉及组间统计比较。
AI.result: SVC隔离后窦性心律最初保持，数分钟后出现窦性停搏，遂启动高位右心房备用起搏。冠状动脉造影显示窦房结动脉严重痉挛。经支持治疗后窦房结功能逐步恢复；术后电压标测证实上腔静脉隔离成功。摘要未报告痉挛具体血管节段定量数据、症状持续时间及随访期心律复发情况。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示PFA行SVC隔离后可出现迟发性窦性停搏，冠脉造影直接支持窦房结动脉痉挛为其可能机制之一。对PFA术后延迟出现的窦性心动过缓或停搏，除消融直接损伤外应警惕冠状动脉痉挛，应及时备好右心房备用起搏并考虑冠脉造影评估；本研究为单例报告，无法确立因果关系，发生率与高危因素尚待更大样本研究。

title: LAA occluder device impeding pulsed field ablation of an anterior mitral line: a case report about the role of a dual energy source
From wrist to heart: clinical validation and real-world translation of wearable and portable AI-enhanced electrocardiography
summary: Wearable and portable electrocardiogram (ECG) devices are shifting cardiovascular monitoring beyond clinician-directed testing, driven by consumer-led self-monitoring, remote care, and preventive cardiology. Artificial intelligence (AI) may enhance the value of these devices by supporting automated interpretation, but clinical translation remains uneven. This narrative review synthesises current evidence on AI-enhanced ECG (AI-ECG) analysis in wearable and portable systems, with emphasis on the gap between technical performance and real-world implementation. Although many advances have been developed using conventional 12-lead ECG datasets, deployment in wearable and portable devices introduces additional challenges related to device-specific signal acquisition, preprocessing, domain shift, and user-led recording. Evidence is most mature for atrial fibrillation detection, while applications across conduction disease, other arrhythmias, structural phenotypes, and prognostic assessment remain earlier in development and are supported by fewer prospective, device-specific evaluations. Across the field, retrospective and dataset-based studies predominate, with limited evidence that improved detection translates into better patient outcomes or health-system efficiency. Future research should evaluate performance using the intended device, population, and clinical pathway, and determine whether AI-ECG changes management without increasing unnecessary investigation or workload. Establishing clinical value, rather than improving classification accuracy alone, will determine the role of wearable and portable AI-ECG in routine cardiovascular care.

AI.tldr: 该叙述性综述指出，可穿戴与便携式设备的 AI-ECG 应用中以房颤检测证据最成熟，但现有研究以回顾性和数据集分析为主，缺乏设备特异性前瞻验证，尚未证明能改善患者结局或提升卫生系统效率。
AI.motivation: 消费级自我监测、远程医疗与预防心脏病学的发展，正把心电监测从医生主导的检查推向可穿戴与便携式设备。人工智能有望实现自动判读、提升这类设备的临床价值，但技术性能与实际落地之间存在明显落差：多数算法基于传统 12 导联心电图数据集开发，迁移到可穿戴设备后需面对采集方式、信号预处理、域偏移（domain shift）以及用户自行记录等额外挑战。本文即针对这一“技术指标优于临床证据”的缺口进行证据梳理。
AI.method: 研究类型为叙述性综述（narrative review），非原始研究，摘要未报告检索数据库、检索时限、纳入文献数量及样本量。综述对象为可穿戴与便携式心电设备中 AI 增强心电分析（AI-ECG）的现有证据，覆盖房颤检测、传导系统疾病、其他心律失常、结构表型识别与预后评估等应用场景。作者重点比较各类应用证据的成熟度（是否具备前瞻性、设备特异性验证），并评估从检出性能提升到患者结局及卫生系统效率改善的证据链完整性；摘要未报告具体统计方法或定量合并分析。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何定量数据（无敏感度、特异度、AUC、效应量、95%CI 或 P 值）。定性结论为：房颤检测的证据最为成熟；传导系统疾病、其他心律失常、结构表型与预后评估等应用仍处于较早期阶段，前瞻性、设备特异性评估较少。整体上，回顾性研究与基于既有数据集的研究占主导，仅有有限证据表明检出能力的提高可转化为更好的患者结局或卫生系统效率。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，可穿戴与便携式 AI-ECG 的临床定位取决于其临床价值而非单纯的分类准确率。未来研究应在目标设备、目标人群和真实临床路径中评估性能，并验证 AI-ECG 是否能改变临床决策而不增加不必要的检查与工作负荷。对电生理实践而言，房颤筛查是目前最可能落地的场景，但设备间算法不可随意套用，解读结果需结合记录质量与人群特征。局限性：本文为叙述性综述，无系统检索与定量合成，未提供可操作的性能阈值或成本效益数据。

Edoxaban antithrombotic therapy in diabetic patients with atrial fibrillation and stable coronary artery disease: the EPIC-CAD trial
summary: Aims The appropriate antithrombotic regimen for diabetic patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) and stable coronary artery disease (CAD) who are at high atherothrombotic risk remains uncertain. We evaluated whether the effects of different antithrombotic strategies differ according to diabetes status.Methods and results The EPIC-CAD (Edoxaban versus Edoxaban with Antiplatelet Agent in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation and Chronic Stable Coronary Artery Disease) was a randomized trial comparing edoxaban monotherapy with dual antithrombotic therapy (edoxaban plus a single antiplatelet agent) in patients with AF and stable CAD. The primary outcome was a composite of death from any cause, myocardial infarction, stroke, systemic embolism, unplanned urgent revascularization, and major or clinically relevant non-major bleeding at 12 months. Among 1040 randomized patients, 421 (40.5%) had diabetes. There were no differences in the incidence of the primary outcome between diabetic and non-diabetic patients [9.7% vs. 11.6%; hazard ratio (HR) 0.82; 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.56-1.20; P = 0.30]. The incidence of the primary outcome at 12 months was significantly lower with edoxaban monotherapy than with dual antithrombotic therapy in both diabetic (6.3% vs. 13.7%; HR 0.44; 95% CI 0.23-0.83; P = 0.01) and non-diabetic patients (6.7% vs. 16.3%; HR 0.39; 95% CI 0.23-0.65; P < 0.001), with no significant interaction between diabetic status and randomized treatment strategy (P for interaction = 0.78).Conclusion The risk of primary outcome was similar between diabetic and non-diabetic patients with AF and CAD. Irrespective of diabetes status, edoxaban monotherapy led to a lower risk of a primary outcome at 12 months than dual antithrombotic therapy.Clinical trial registration EPIC-CAD ClinicalTrials.gov number: NCT03718559.

AI.tldr: 在合并稳定冠心病的房颤患者中，糖尿病患者与非糖尿病患者12个月主要复合终点风险相似（9.7% vs 11.6%）；无论是否合并糖尿病，艾多沙班单药治疗的主要终点风险均显著低于艾多沙班联合单一抗血小板药的双联抗栓治疗。
AI.motivation: 合并房颤与稳定冠心病的糖尿病患者同时面临血栓栓塞、动脉粥样硬化血栓事件与出血风险，其最佳抗栓方案（长期口服抗凝药单药还是联合抗血小板药）尚无定论，既往证据也未明确糖尿病状态是否影响不同抗栓策略的疗效与安全性。
AI.method: EPIC-CAD 为随机对照试验（NCT03718559），纳入房颤合并稳定冠心病患者共1040例，其中421例（40.5%）合并糖尿病；随机比较艾多沙班单药与双联抗栓治疗（艾多沙班联合单一抗血小板药）。主要终点为12个月全因死亡、心肌梗死、卒中、系统性栓塞、非计划紧急血运重建以及大出血或临床相关非大出血的复合终点；并按糖尿病状态进行亚组与交互作用分析，采用风险比（HR）及95%置信区间（CI）评价。
AI.result: 糖尿病与非糖尿病患者的12个月主要终点发生率无显著差异（9.7% vs 11.6%；HR 0.82；95%CI 0.56-1.20；P=0.30）。艾多沙班单药治疗的主要终点发生率在糖尿病患者中显著低于双联抗栓治疗（6.3% vs 13.7%；HR 0.44；95%CI 0.23-0.83；P=0.01），在非糖尿病患者中同样显著降低（6.7% vs 16.3%；HR 0.39；95%CI 0.23-0.65；P<0.001）；糖尿病状态与随机治疗策略之间无显著交互作用（交互作用P=0.78）。
AI.conclusion: 在合并稳定冠心病的房颤患者中，糖尿病状态并未显著增加12个月主要复合终点风险；无论是否合并糖尿病，艾多沙班单药抗栓较双联抗栓均可显著降低主要终点风险，提示此类高危患者可优先考虑单药抗凝、避免常规联合抗血小板。本研究为预先设定的亚组分析，糖尿病患者样本量有限，结果需更多证据验证，出血与缺血事件的各个组成部分也需进一步细化评估。

title: Sphingomyelin as a key negative mediator in atrial fibrillation via lipid profiling analysis and functional identification
summary: Aims Atrial fibrillation (AF) has emerged as one of the most prevalent cardiac arrhythmias globally, with its incidence continuously rising, thereby elevating it to a major public health concern. The heart is known for its high lipid content, and disorders or abnormalities in lipid metabolism are frequently associated with cardiovascular diseases. This study aimed to investigate the regulatory roles of lipids in AF.Methods and results Using tree-based ensemble learning-assisted lipidomics, sphingomyelin was identified as a key differential metabolite and found to be significantly reduced in AF patients. Exogenous supplementation of sphingomyelin significantly attenuated acetylcholine-CaCl2-induced and angiotensin II-induced AF, fibrosis, and inflammation in mice. Furthermore, decreased sphingomyelin levels were attributed to increased activity of sphingomyelin phosphodiesterases (SMPDs) under AF conditions. Mechanistically, RNA-Seq analysis demonstrated that sphingomyelin inhibits AF-induced activation of the Rap1 signalling pathway, a finding corroborated by overexpression and knockdown of RAP1 in vivo.Conclusion Together, these findings highlight the therapeutic potential of sphingomyelin and SMPD inhibitors in mitigating AF through inhibition of the Rap1 signalling pathway, thereby establishing the targeting of sphingomyelin metabolism as a viable and novel treatment strategy for AF.

AI.tldr: 基于树模型辅助的脂质组学发现房颤患者鞘磷脂显著降低，外源补充鞘磷脂可通过抑制 Rap1 信号通路减轻小鼠房颤、纤维化与炎症。
AI.motivation: 房颤是全球最常见的心律失常之一，发病率持续上升，已成为重大公共卫生问题；心脏富含脂质，脂质代谢紊乱常与心血管疾病相关，但脂质（尤其鞘磷脂）在房颤中的调控作用及机制尚不清楚，既往证据存在缺口。
AI.method: 研究采用基于树的集成学习辅助脂质组学，比较房颤患者与对照的脂质代谢谱以筛选关键差异代谢物；在乙酰胆碱-CaCl2 诱导及血管紧张素 II 诱导的小鼠房颤模型中给予外源鞘磷脂补充，评估房颤诱发率、纤维化与炎症；检测房颤条件下鞘磷脂磷酸二酯酶（SMPD）活性；并通过 RNA-Seq、体内 RAP1 过表达与敲低实验验证机制。摘要未报告样本量、终点定义细节及具体统计方法。
AI.result: 鞘磷脂被鉴定为关键差异代谢物，在房颤患者中显著降低；外源补充鞘磷脂可显著减轻小鼠由乙酰胆碱-CaCl2 及血管紧张素 II 诱导的房颤、纤维化与炎症；房颤条件下鞘磷脂水平下降归因于 SMPD 活性升高；RNA-Seq 显示鞘磷脂抑制房颤诱导的 Rap1 信号通路激活，体内 RAP1 过表达与敲低实验证实该机制。摘要未报告具体效应量、95% 置信区间与 P 值。
AI.conclusion: 鞘磷脂及 SMPD 抑制剂可通过抑制 Rap1 信号通路减轻房颤，提示靶向鞘磷脂代谢是房颤治疗的新策略；但现有证据主要来自动物模型与代谢物关联分析，人体因果性与临床获益尚待前瞻性研究验证。

title: Cognitive function and telemedicine-based, village doctor-led care for atrial fibrillation
summary: Aims Cognitive impairment is common among older patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). We aimed to evaluate whether baseline cognitive function modifies the effectiveness of a telemedicine-based, village doctor-led integrated care in older patients with AF.Methods This was a post hoc subgroup analysis of the MIRACLE-AF cluster-randomized trial conducted across 30 village clinics in China from December 2020 to May 2024. Rural participants aged ≥65 years with AF received telemedicine-based, village doctor-led integrated AF care or usual care. Participants were categorized by baseline Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) score into severe cognitive impairment (MMSE < 18), mild-to-moderate cognitive impairment (MMSE 18-23), and preserved cognition (MMSE ≥ 24). The primary outcome was a composite of cardiovascular death, all strokes, hospitalization for worsening heart failure or acute coronary syndrome, and emergency visits for AF.Results Among 1039 participants enrolled in the MIRACLE-AF trial [mean (SD) age, 75.8 (5.7) years; 460 women (44.3%)], 1028 (98.9%) had baseline MMSE assessed (388 with MMSE < 18, 305 with MMSE 18-23, and 335 with MMSE ≥ 24). Compared with control, the intervention reduced the risk of the primary outcome among patients with MMSE 18-23 [adjusted hazard ratio (HR), 0.56; 95% CI, 0.34-0.92], MMSE ≥ 24 (adjusted HR, 0.55; 95% CI, 0.32-0.93), and MMSE < 18 (adjusted HR, 0.86; 95% CI, 0.54-1.35). P for interaction was 0.336.Conclusion A telemedicine-based, village doctor-led integrated care model was associated with favourable outcomes across baseline cognitive strata, warranting further evaluation among cognitively vulnerable adults with AF in rural settings.Clinical trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov (identifier NCT04622514).

AI.tldr: MIRACLE-AF 事后亚组分析显示，基于远程医疗、乡村医生主导的房颤整合管理在基线认知功能各分层（含重度认知障碍）中均与更佳结局相关，且认知状态未见显著效应修饰（交互 P=0.336）。
AI.motivation: 认知功能障碍在老年房颤患者中普遍存在，而这类患者常因依从性差、自我管理能力受限被排除于正规管理路径之外。既往研究已证实远程医疗联合基层医生主导的整合管理可改善房颤结局，但基线认知功能是否影响该模式的获益（即是否存在效应修饰）尚不明确，直接关系到是否应将认知脆弱人群纳入此类干预。
AI.method: MIRACLE-AF 整群随机试验的事后亚组分析，2020 年 12 月至 2024 年 5 月在中国 30 个村卫生室开展；纳入≥65 岁农村房颤患者 1039 例，随机接受远程医疗支持、乡村医生主导的房颤整合管理或常规照护。按基线简易精神状态检查（MMSE）分为重度认知障碍（<18）、轻中度认知障碍（18–23）与认知保留（≥24）三层。主要终点为心血管死亡、全部卒中、心衰恶化或急性冠脉综合征住院、以及房颤相关急诊就诊的复合终点；采用校正后 Cox 模型计算风险比并按分层检验交互作用。
AI.result: 共 1028 例（98.9%）完成基线 MMSE 评估：MMSE<18 者 388 例、18–23 者 305 例、≥24 者 335 例；总体平均年龄 75.8（5.7）岁，女性 460 例（44.3%）。与对照组相比，干预组主要终点风险在 MMSE 18–23 层（校正 HR 0.56，95%CI 0.34–0.92）、MMSE≥24 层（校正 HR 0.55，95%CI 0.32–0.93）显著降低，在 MMSE<18 层未达统计学显著（校正 HR 0.86，95%CI 0.54–1.35）；交互作用 P=0.336。各层绝对事件率摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 在该农村老年房颤队列中，乡村医生主导的远程医疗整合管理在认知保留及轻中度认知障碍患者中获益明确，重度认知障碍者方向一致但置信区间跨 1，整体无统计学交互，提示获益可跨认知分层延伸。结果支持将认知脆弱人群纳入基层房颤管理路径，但本研究为事后亚组分析、重度认知障碍层效能不足，结论需在认知脆弱人群中进一步前瞻性验证（NCT04622514）。

title: Development and validation of the GLORIA-AF Stroke Weighted Risk Score for patients with atrial fibrillation
summary: Aims Accurate stroke risk stratification is central to anticoagulation decision-making in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF), but conventional scores may not fully capture risk heterogeneity. We aimed to develop and externally validate an interpretable weighted score using a time-to-event framework.Methods and results GLORIA-AF Phase II/III data were used to evaluate 17 baseline predictors using LASSO-penalized Cox regression with stability selection; coefficients were converted into integer weights. Performance was assessed using discrimination, calibration, integrated discrimination improvement (IDI), continuous net reclassification improvement (NRI), and decision curve analysis. External validation was performed in EORP-AF and APHRS-AF registries. Among 20 517 patients included in the derivation cohort [mean (SD) age, 69.9 (10.3) years; 9196 women (44.8%)], 487 (2.4%) had stroke, and 17 397 (84.8%) were receiving anticoagulation at baseline. Ten selected predictors formed a 0-23-point score. The derived score achieved a C-index of 0.661 (95% CI, 0.636-0.685), higher than CHA2DS2-VA (0.626; P < 0.001), CHA2DS2-VASc (0.615; P < 0.001), and the unweighted score (P = 0.016), with no significant difference from the full Cox or machine learning models. In external validation (8309 patients; 147 strokes), the C-index was 0.652 (95% CI, 0.614-0.690) vs. 0.616 for CHA2DS2-VA (95% CI, 0.598-0.634; P < 0.001). IDI/NRI, calibration, and decision curve analyses supported improved risk differentiation, close calibration, and generally greater net benefit than CHA2DS2-VA. The score retained higher discrimination than CHA2DS2-VA among patients without baseline anticoagulation (P < 0.001).Conclusion The GLORIA-AF Stroke Weighted Risk Score provides risk refinement beyond CHA2DS2-VA while retaining discrimination consistent with more complex models. External validation supports its transportability and potential adjunctive role in guideline-directed thromboembolic risk assessment.

AI.tldr: 在GLORIA-AF等三项注册研究中，含10项预测因子、0–23分的GLORIA-AF卒中加权风险评分将房颤患者卒中区分度提高至C指数0.661，外部验证为0.652，均优于CHA2DS2-VA。
AI.motivation: 准确的卒中风险分层是房颤抗凝决策的核心环节，但CHA2DS2-VASc、CHA2DS2-VA等传统评分区分度有限，难以充分反映风险异质性。临床上需要一种既可解释、又便于床旁使用的加权评分，并需要有外部人群数据验证其可移植性；这正是既往证据的缺口。
AI.method: 研究为风险评分的开发与外部验证研究，数据来自GLORIA-AF Ⅱ/Ⅲ期注册。推导队列共20517例，平均（SD）年龄69.9（10.3）岁，女性9196例（44.8%），基线84.8%已接受抗凝治疗。研究评估了17项基线预测因子，采用LASSO惩罚Cox回归结合稳定性选择，将回归系数转换为整数权重。主要终点为卒中，采用时间-事件框架。模型性能通过区分度（C指数）、校准、综合判别改善（IDI）、连续净重分类改善（NRI）及决策曲线分析评价；外部验证在EORP-AF与APHRS-AF注册（8309例，147例卒中）中完成。随访时长摘要未报告。
AI.result: 推导队列中487例（2.4%）发生卒中，最终10项预测因子入选，构成0–23分评分。推导队列C指数为0.661（95%CI 0.636–0.685），高于CHA2DS2-VA的0.626（P<0.001）、CHA2DS2-VASc的0.615（P<0.001）以及未加权评分（P=0.016）；但与完整Cox模型及机器学习模型无显著差异。外部验证C指数为0.652（95%CI 0.614–0.690），高于CHA2DS2-VA的0.616（95%CI 0.598–0.634；P<0.001）。IDI/NRI、校准及决策曲线分析支持该评分改善风险区分、校准良好，且净获益总体优于CHA2DS2-VA。在基线未抗凝患者中，该评分的区分度仍优于CHA2DS2-VA（P<0.001）。摘要未报告IDI、NRI的具体数值及随访时间。
AI.conclusion: GLORIA-AF卒中加权风险评分在区分度上与更复杂的模型相当，同时较CHA2DS2-VA实现了风险细化，外部验证也支持其可移植性，提示其可能作为指南导向血栓栓塞风险评估的辅助工具。局限性在于：推导队列中84.8%的患者已接受抗凝治疗，卒中事件数较少（2.4%），C指数的绝对提升幅度有限（约0.035），且对临床净获益及抗凝决策的实际改变仍需前瞻性验证。

title: Improved patient value after implementing same day discharge for patients undergoing pulmonary vein isolation
summary: Aims Pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) is an effective intervention to treat atrial fibrillation, which is increasingly prevalent. Same-day discharge (SDD) is a strategic approach to limit procedure-related costs. This study aimed to compare healthcare utilization, costs, and clinical outcomes before and after implementation of an SDD protocol.Methods and results This retrospective study included 2987 patients undergoing PVI between 1 January 2016 and 1 April 2021. Baseline characteristics, pre-, peri-, and post-procedure healthcare utilization and clinical outcomes were compared before (cohort A; n = 1379) and after (Cohort B; n = 1608) implementation of the SDD protocol using bivariate and multivariate analyses. show that cohort B vs. cohort A had lower all-cause 90-day mortality (0% vs. 0.3%, P = 0.031), no differences in re-ablation < 1 year (P = 0.286), as well as in complications: bleedings (P = 0.177), tamponade < 30 days (P = 0.157), phrenic nerve injury (P = 0.984), thromboembolic complication < 72 h (P = 0.212), or vascular complications (P = 0.290). In terms of healthcare utilization and costs, cohort B had significantly less peri-procedure hospital admission costs (€721.52 vs. €1011.78, P < 0.001) and less total peri- and post-procedure costs (€840.37 vs. €1152.94, P < 0.001). Adjusted for all baseline characteristics, the post-implementation cohort showed on average €315 lower total costs per patient.Conclusion The implementation of the SDD protocol was associated with comparable complication rates while significantly reducing both peri- and post-procedure healthcare utilization and costs, thereby enhancing patient value. This indicates a potential margin for further cost reductions and increased efficiency.

AI.tldr: 单中心回顾性队列显示，实施 PVI 当日出院（SDD）方案后，围术期及术后总费用显著降低，人均校正后节省约 315 欧元，且并发症与再消融率无差异。
AI.motivation: 房颤患病率持续上升，PVI 是有效治疗手段，但常规住院观察带来的医疗资源占用与费用压力日益突出。SDD 被视为控制手术相关成本的关键策略，然而既往证据多缺乏对 SDD 方案实施前后医疗资源利用、费用与临床结局的系统对比，尤其是同时评估安全性与经济效益的数据不足。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入 2016 年 1 月 1 日至 2021 年 4 月 1 日期间接受 PVI 的 2987 例患者，按 SDD 方案实施前后分为队列 A（实施前，n=1379）与队列 B（实施后，n=1608）。比较两组基线特征、术前/围术期/术后医疗资源利用及临床结局，采用双变量与多变量分析；费用以欧元计，并对基线特征进行校正后比较人均总费用。
AI.result: 队列 B 与 A 相比：90 天全因死亡更低（0% vs 0.3%，P=0.031）；1 年内再消融无差异（P=0.286）；并发症方面，出血（P=0.177）、30 天内心脏压塞（P=0.157）、膈神经损伤（P=0.984）、72 小时内血栓栓塞事件（P=0.212）、血管并发症（P=0.290）均无差异。费用方面，队列 B 围术期住院费用显著更低（721.52 vs 1011.78 欧元，P<0.001），围术期加术后总费用亦显著更低（840.37 vs 1152.94 欧元，P<0.001）；校正全部基线特征后，实施后队列人均总费用平均降低 315 欧元。
AI.conclusion: 实施 PVI 当日出院方案与相当的并发症发生率相关，同时显著降低围术期及术后医疗资源利用与费用，提升患者价值，提示在保证安全的前提下仍有进一步降本增效的空间。但本研究为单中心回顾性设计，费用数据受当地医疗支付体系影响，外推性受限；SDD 的推广仍需前瞻性及多中心数据验证，并需关注出院后早期随访与患者筛选标准。

title: A computed tomography-based radiomics-clinical model incorporating left atrial and proximal pulmonary vein features predicts recurrence after radiofrequency catheter ablation of atrial fibrillation: a multicenter study.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: To develop and validate a CCTA-based radiomics-clinical model for predicting late recurrence after radiofrequency catheter ablation (RFCA) in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF).

METHODS: This retrospective multicenter study included 379 patients who underwent first-time RFCA and preprocedural CCTA at two centers (Center A, n = 238; Center B, n = 141). Patients from Center A were randomly divided into a training cohort (n = 166) and an internal validation cohort (n = 72) at a 7:3 ratio, whereas patients from Center B served as the external validation cohort. A TotalSegmentator model based on the nnU-Net v2 framework was used for fully automated segmentation of the left atrial body, left atrial appendage, and proximal pulmonary vein trunks, defined as the segments from the ostia to the first major bifurcations. These structures were merged and defined as the left atrial complex (LAC), which served as the unified region of interest for radiomics analysis. After assessing feature stability and reducing dimensionality, key features were selected to construct a radiomics score and an XGBoost-based radiomics model. A combined model was then developed by integrating the radiomics score with independent clinical predictors. Model performance was assessed using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), and model comparisons were performed using the DeLong test.

RESULTS: Of the 379 included patients, 106 (28.0%) developed late AF recurrence within 2 years after ablation. Multivariable logistic regression identified sex and left ventricular ejection fraction as independent clinical predictors. The combined model achieved AUCs of 0.896, 0.894, and 0.869 in the training, internal validation, and external validation cohorts, respectively, consistently outperforming the radiomics model (0.874, 0.840, and 0.787, respectively) and the clinical model (0.694, 0.658, and 0.704, respectively). These findings indicate good predictive performance, with maintained performance in the external validation cohort.

CONCLUSION: The CCTA-based radiomics-clinical model derived from the LAC showed good performance for predicting late recurrence after RFCA for AF and may serve as a practical tool for individualized preprocedural risk stratification.

AI.tldr: 多中心回顾性研究显示，基于 CCTA 的左心房复合体影像组学联合临床模型可预测房颤射频消融术后 2 年晚期复发，外部验证 AUC 达 0.869。
AI.motivation: 射频导管消融是房颤节律控制的重要手段，但术后晚期复发率仍较高，术前缺乏可靠的个体化风险分层工具。既往影像组学研究多聚焦左心房整体或肺静脉开口单一结构，未将左心耳与近端肺静脉干纳入统一感兴趣区，且多为单中心、缺乏外部验证，模型泛化能力不明。本研究拟构建并验证融合左心房与近端肺静脉特征的 CCTA 影像组学-临床模型。
AI.method: 回顾性多中心研究，纳入两个中心首次接受射频导管消融且术前完成 CCTA 的房颤患者 379 例（A 中心 238 例，按 7:3 随机分为训练集 166 例与内部验证集 72 例；B 中心 141 例作为外部验证集）。采用基于 nnU-Net v2 框架的 TotalSegmentator 模型全自动分割左心房体、左心耳及近端肺静脉干（自开口至首个主要分叉处），三者融合定义为左心房复合体（LAC），作为统一影像组学感兴趣区。经特征稳定性评估与降维后筛选关键特征，构建影像组学评分及基于 XGBoost 的影像组学模型，再将影像组学评分与独立临床预测因子整合为联合模型。以 ROC 曲线下面积（AUC）评价模型性能，采用 DeLong 检验进行模型间比较。主要终点为消融术后 2 年内的晚期房颤复发。
AI.result: 379 例患者中 106 例（28.0%）在术后 2 年内出现晚期房颤复发。多因素 logistic 回归确定性别与左心室射血分数为独立临床预测因子。联合模型在训练集、内部验证集和外部验证集的 AUC 分别为 0.896、0.894 和 0.869，均优于影像组学模型（分别为 0.874、0.840、0.787）和临床模型（分别为 0.694、0.658、0.704）；模型间比较采用 DeLong 检验，具体 P 值摘要未报告。联合模型在外部验证集中性能保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 基于 LAC 的 CCTA 影像组学-临床联合模型对房颤射频消融术后晚期复发具有良好的预测效能，可作为术前个体化风险分层的实用工具。其临床意义在于可在消融术前无创识别高危复发人群，辅助筛选适合的患者并优化随访策略。局限性包括：本研究为回顾性设计、仅纳入两个中心、样本量有限，复发判定与分割流程细节、DeLong 检验的具体 P 值及校准度指标摘要未报告，模型尚需前瞻性多中心研究进一步验证后方可推广至电生理临床实践。

title: Machine learning for enhancing the ablation outcomes using recurrence quantification analysis in human persistent atrial fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Several ablation strategies, including dominant frequency (DF), complex fractionated atrial electrograms (CFAEs), and rotors, have been used to target the drivers of atrial fibrillation (AF). The success rate of these strategies remains suboptimal.

OBJECTIVE: This work aims to develop a model using recurrence quantification analysis (RQA) variables and machine learning (ML) algorithms to predict the responses of ablating intracardiac electrograms (EGMs) and their impact on terminating AF and cycle length changes.

METHODS: 3206 non-contact EGMs were collected from 10 persistent AF patients. Two classes were considered as labels based on EGM's responses to ablation (positive and negative responses). Nine RQA-based variables were extracted from the EGMs. Ten ML classifiers were trained and tested using leave one patient out a 10-fold cross-validation (LOPOCV)).

RESULTS: The decision tree outperformed other ML models, achieving a balanced accuracy of 73.46%, F1_score of 74.05, and AUROC of 0.74. The high performance was achieved using the three most important features (determinism, longest diagonal line, and recurrence rate) with the importance of 30%, 23%, and 13%, respectively. Statistical analysis showed high values of all median RQA variables for the EGM's negative responses over the positive ones.

CONCLUSIONS: Our results show that RQA variables can effectively highlight the electrophysiological differences between EGM positive and negative responses to catheter ablation. The model might aid cardiologists in predicting ablation outcomes and reducing the number of unsuccessful ablations. A comparison between the proposed approach and previous works shows the superiority of this model.

AI.tldr: 在10例持续性房颤患者中，利用复发定量分析（RQA）变量结合机器学习，可从非接触心内电图预测消融反应，决策树模型平衡准确率73.46%、AUROC 0.74，阴性反应电图RQA值整体偏高。
AI.motivation: 以优势频率、复杂碎裂心房电图和转子为靶点的驱动灶消融策略成功率仍不理想，临床上缺乏在放电前预判某一位点心内电图是否会对消融产生反应的工具。既往研究多依赖频域或形态学特征，未系统评估电图的非线性动力学（复发）特征能否区分消融敏感与非敏感位点，也缺少与机器学习结合的预测模型。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性电生理研究，纳入10例持续性AF患者，采集3206个非接触心内电图；以电图对消融的反应分为阳性与阴性两类作为标签，从每个电图中提取9个RQA变量（包括确定性、最长对角线长度、复发率等）。训练并比较10种机器学习分类器，采用留一患者交叉验证（LOPOCV，10折）评估性能，指标为平衡准确率、F1分数与AUROC，并分析特征重要性。
AI.result: 决策树模型表现最优，平衡准确率73.46%、F1分数74.05、AUROC 0.74；仅用三个最重要特征即可达到该性能，分别为确定性（重要性30%）、最长对角线长度（23%）和复发率（13%）。统计分析显示，消融阴性反应电图的所有RQA变量中位数均高于阳性反应电图。消融后AF终止率、周长变化等临床终点摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: RQA变量能够刻画消融阳性与阴性反应电图之间的电生理差异，据此构建的机器学习模型有望辅助术者预判消融反应、减少无效放电，且性能优于既往报道方法。局限性明确：样本量仅10例患者、3206个电图，缺乏AF终止与长期窦律维持等硬终点，留一患者验证下的准确率仍有限，需多中心大样本及前瞻性验证后方可进入临床决策流程。

title: Prevalence, Incidence, and Impact of Cancer in Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of 70,000,000 Patients
summary: Background and aims Contemporary studies indicate that atrial fibrillation (AF) is common in patients with cancer and adversely affects their prognosis. AF and cancer also share several risk factors. Nevertheless, the prevalence, incidence, and overall impact of cancer in patients with AF are not well defined. This study was designed to estimate the prevalence and incidence of cancer in an AF population and to evaluate its effect on clinical outcomes.Methods A systematic review and meta-analysis were performed following international guidelines. We searched PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, and Cochrane Library for studies reporting the prevalence and incidence of cancer in patients with AF. Data were extracted from the included studies and pooled using a random-effects model.Results The overall prevalence of cancer among AF patients was 1141.01 per 10,000 (95% CI: 975.43-1330.56; 95% PI: 219.37-4251.57), with an incidence of 172.22 per 10,000 person-years (95% CI: 127.76-232.15; 95% PI: 40.32-735.69). Both prevalence and incidence varied according to cancer type, patient gender, and comorbid conditions. Cancer was associated with a significantly increased risk of all-cause mortality (OR: 1.83, 95% CI: 1.60-2.08) and bleeding (OR: 1.62, 95% CI: 1.37-1.92). No significant associations were observed for cardiovascular death or stroke/systemic embolism.Conclusions Cancer is common in AF patients, affecting approximately 11% of this population. In addition, the incidence of cancer in AF patients is substantial and should not be overlooked. Cancer is associated with worse clinical outcomes in AF patients, including a more than 1.8-fold increased risk of all-cause mortality and 1.6-fold increased risk of bleeding.

AI.tldr: 在房颤人群中癌症总体患病率约11.4%（1141.01/万），发病率为172.22/万人年；合并癌症使全因死亡风险增加1.83倍、出血风险增加1.62倍。
AI.motivation: 当代研究提示房颤在肿瘤患者中常见且恶化预后，两者还共享多项危险因素；但反向问题，即房颤患者中癌症的患病率、发病率及其对临床结局的整体影响，尚缺乏明确定量证据，本研究即针对这一证据缺口进行系统评价与荟萃分析。
AI.method: 系统评价与荟萃分析，遵循国际指南实施。检索 PubMed、Web of Science、Embase 与 Cochrane Library 中报告房颤患者癌症患病率与发病率的研究，提取数据后采用随机效应模型合并；标题提示累计纳入约7000万例患者，但摘要未报告纳入研究数量、随访时长及各终点定义细节。
AI.result: 房颤患者癌症总体患病率为1141.01/万（95%CI 975.43–1330.56；95%PI 219.37–4251.57），发病率为172.22/万人年（95%CI 127.76–232.15；95%PI 40.32–735.69）；患病率与发病率随癌症类型、患者性别及合并症不同而变化。合并癌症显著升高全因死亡风险（OR 1.83，95%CI 1.60–2.08）与出血风险（OR 1.62，95%CI 1.37–1.92）；心血管死亡及卒中/系统性栓塞未见显著关联（摘要未报告具体效应量）。
AI.conclusion: 癌症在房颤患者中并不少见，约累及该人群11%，且发病率可观、不容忽视；合并癌症者全因死亡与出血风险明显升高，提示对房颤患者应重视肿瘤筛查与个体化抗凝、出血风险评估。局限性：摘要未报告纳入研究数量、异质性、各癌种及终点定义细节，预测区间较宽提示研究间差异较大，结果需结合原始研究质量解读。

title: Relationship between paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and the Osaka Prognostic Score
summary: Background The Osaka Prognostic Score (OPS), which is based on C‑reactive protein (CRP), total lymphocyte count (TLC), and albumin (ALB), has been reported to have prognostic value in several types of cancer. Recent studies have revealed a relationship between the OPS and cardiovascular diseases. The aim of this study was to evaluate the relationship between the OPS and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF), a significant rhythm disorder.Methods A total of 941 individuals, including 198 patients with a history of AF and 743 patients without AF as the control group, were included in the study. These groups were compared in terms of demographic characteristics and laboratory findings.Results Univariable and multivariable binary logistic regression analyses revealed an independent relationship between the OPS and AF (odds ratio [OR]: 3.37, p < 0.001). In receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis, OPS above a cut-off level of 0.5 was associated with the presence of AF, with a sensitivity of 55.6% and a specificity of 77.4% (area under the ROC curve [AUC]: 0.682, p < 0.001).Conclusion This study found a relationship between the OPS and paroxysmal AF attacks. The OPS may provide additional information for the clinical evaluation of patients with paroxysmal AF in daily practice.

AI.tldr: 在941例受试者中，由CRP、总淋巴细胞计数和白蛋白构成的大阪预后评分（OPS）与阵发性房颤独立相关（OR 3.37，P<0.001），提示这一炎症-营养复合指标或可辅助房颤的临床评估。
AI.motivation: OPS 是基于 C 反应蛋白（CRP）、总淋巴细胞计数（TLC）与白蛋白（ALB）计算的炎症-营养复合评分，既往主要用于多种肿瘤的预后判断，近期研究提示其与心血管疾病相关；但 OPS 与阵发性房颤这一常见心律失常之间是否存在关联尚缺乏证据，本研究即针对这一缺口展开。
AI.method: 单中心病例对照（横断面）设计，共纳入 941 例受试者，其中有房颤病史者 198 例为房颤组，无房颤者 743 例为对照组；比较两组人口学特征与实验室检查结果，采用单因素及多因素二分类 logistic 回归分析 OPS 与房颤的独立关联，并以 ROC 曲线评估 OPS 对房颤存在的判别能力、确定最佳切点及敏感度、特异度。房颤类型限定为阵发性房颤，终点定义为房颤病史/房颤存在，随访时间与混杂因素具体校正项摘要未报告。
AI.result: 单因素与多因素二分类 logistic 回归均显示 OPS 与房颤存在独立相关（OR 3.37，P<0.001；摘要未报告 95%CI 及具体校正变量）。ROC 分析中，OPS 切点取 0.5 时与房颤存在相关，敏感度 55.6%、特异度 77.4%，曲线下面积（AUC）0.682（P<0.001），判别能力属中等偏弱。两组人口学与实验室指标的具体差异数值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 本研究发现 OPS 与阵发性房颤发作相关，作为由 CRP、淋巴细胞计数与白蛋白衍生的低成本指标，OPS 或可在日常实践中为阵发性房颤患者的临床评估提供补充信息。但该关联为横断面观察，无法推断因果关系；AUC 0.682 提示其单独判别价值有限，且为单中心、样本量中等、缺乏外部验证，尚不能替代现有房颤筛查与评估手段，需前瞻性队列进一步验证其预测与预后价值。

title: Predictors of Heart Failure Hospitalization in Patients with the First Marketed Leadless Pacemaker -Micra VR.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Micra VR, the first leadless pacemaker, offers a high effectiveness and lower complication rate than conventional transvenous pacemakers. However, little is known about heart failure hospitalization after Micra VR implantation. We investigated the incidence and predictors of heart failure hospitalization in patients who underwent de novo Micra VR implantations.

METHODS: Ninety-four consecutive patients who underwent de novo Micra VR implantation (mean age 84.6±6.9 years, 45 males) were enrolled. Clinical outcomes were evaluated during follow-up, and predictors of heart failure hospitalization were assessed.

RESULTS: During the mean follow-up period of 640±392 days, 17 (18.1%) patients were hospitalized due to heart failure post-implantations. Heart failure hospitalization was associated with a history of atrial fibrillation and reduced left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF≤50%). Multivariate analysis revealed that a history of AF (hazard ratio [HR], 5.77; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.64-20.3; P = 0.006) and reduced LVEF (LVEF≤50%) (HR, 7.04; 95% CI, 1.89-26.2; P = 0.004) were independent risk factors for heart failure hospitalization. hospitalization.

CONCLUSION: The presence of AF history and reduced LVEF were predictors of heart failure hospitalization in patients with Micra VR.

AI.tldr: 94例植入Micra VR无导线起搏器的患者中，18.1%在平均约640天随访内因心衰住院，房颤病史与LVEF≤50%是独立预测因素。
AI.motivation: Micra VR是首个上市的無导线起搏器，与经静脉起搏相比有效率高、并发症少，但植入后心衰住院的发生率及其预测因素尚缺乏数据。既往关于无导线起搏器预后的研究多聚焦于植入成功率与操作并发症，对术后心衰这一重要临床结局的报道有限，本研究旨在填补这一证据缺口。
AI.method: 单中心连续纳入94例行de novo Micra VR植入的患者（平均年龄84.6±6.9岁，男性45例），随访期间评估临床结局，主要观察指标为植入后心衰住院；采用多因素分析（以风险比HR报告，提示为时间-事件分析，具体统计模型摘要未报告）筛选心衰住院的预测因素。研究为观察性设计，无对照组，摘要未报告次要终点、随访失访率及起搏比例等参数。
AI.result: 平均随访640±392天，17例（18.1%）因心衰住院。单因素比较显示心衰住院与房颤病史及左心室射血分数降低（LVEF≤50%）相关。多因素分析显示，房颤病史（HR 5.77，95%CI 1.64-20.3，P=0.006）与LVEF≤50%（HR 7.04，95%CI 1.89-26.2，P=0.004）为心衰住院的独立危险因素。
AI.conclusion: 房颤病史与LVEF降低是无导线起搏（Micra VR）患者术后心衰住院的独立预测因素；提示对合并房颤或射血分数减低的患者，术前应加强风险评估、术后强化心衰管理与随访监测（如优化心率/节律控制与心室起搏负荷）。局限性包括样本量小、单中心、观察性设计无对照、随访时间有限，且摘要未报告起搏比例、心衰住院的具体定义与病因等细节，结论需更大样本前瞻性研究验证。

title: Characterization of Patients with Atrial Fibrillation Treated Inadequately with Anticoagulants: Why Hospitalization Is Not an Opportunity to Correct Errors
summary: Background Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a common cardiac arrhythmia. Prevalence increases with age. It is a major public health concern due to high risk of thromboembolic complications such as stroke and systemic embolism. Direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) have been shown to have improved safety and efficacy profiles and are the preferred therapy in all recent guidelines. However, patients are still discharged from internal medicine wards without appropriate DOAC therapy.Objectives To investigate the effectiveness of hospitalization in correcting inappropriate therapy for AF in patients who were hospitalized in the internal medicine departments for any reason and discharged without receiving DOAC therapy.Methods In this retrospective cohort study, we gathered data from electronic medical records at Sheba Medical Center on 222 patients. The patients were divided into three groups based on the anticoagulation therapy they received.Results The patient cohort (mean age of 77.1 years; 42.3% males; 21.6% presented with cognitive impairment. Researchers identified several potential contraindications for DOACs (renal disease in 24.3%, mechanical valves in 14.4%). When comparing patients with and without DOAC contraindications, there were no statistically significant differences regarding cognitive impairment rates or the lack of anticoagulation therapy. We further divided patients who did not receive DOACs into two groups: 134 due to contraindications and 88 mistakenly. Between these groups, baseline factors showed no statistically significant differences.Conclusions We found that older patients received less standardized care. Findings emphasize the need to consider individual patient characteristics and co-morbidities to eliminate management errors and improve the quality of clinical care.

AI.tldr: 回顾性队列显示，222例房颤患者从内科病房出院时均未接受 DOAC 治疗，住院并未成为纠正抗凝疏漏的窗口；其中88例属误判性未用药，且有无禁忌者之间基线无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 房颤随年龄增长而高发，卒中和体循环栓塞风险高，DOAC 已被最新指南列为优选抗凝方案。然而临床实践中仍有大量患者在内科病房出院时未获得恰当的 DOAC 抗凝，既往证据对“住院是否可用于纠正此类不当治疗”以及误判性未用药与真正禁忌之间如何区分仍缺乏系统描述。
AI.method: 以色列 Sheba 医疗中心开展的单中心回顾性队列研究，数据取自电子病历，共纳入222例因任何原因入住内科病房并在出院时未接受 DOAC 治疗的房颤患者（平均年龄77.1岁，男性42.3%，认知障碍21.6%）。按所接受抗凝治疗分为三组（各组例数摘要未报告），并进一步将未使用 DOAC 者分为有禁忌证组（134例）与误判未用药组（88例）。终点为住院是否纠正了不当抗凝、DOAC 禁忌证分布及其与未抗凝的关联；具体终点定义与统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 队列中潜在 DOAC 禁忌证包括肾病24.3%、机械瓣14.4%。有禁忌证与无禁忌证者相比，认知障碍比例及未接受抗凝治疗的比例均无统计学显著差异；134例禁忌证组与88例误判未用药组之间各项基线因素亦无统计学显著差异。作者同时指出，高龄患者接受的诊疗更不规范化。各比较的具体效应量、95%CI 与 P 值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 住院过程未能有效纠正房颤抗凝不当，相当比例患者被错误地判定为存在禁忌证而未用 DOAC，高龄患者问题尤为突出，提示需结合个体特征与合并症进行规范评估。局限性为单中心回顾性设计、样本量有限、缺乏效应量与置信区间，且摘要未给出三组抗凝方案的具体构成，结论需前瞻性研究验证。

title: Right Atrium–Dominant Single‐Loop Biatrial Tachycardia Mimicking Reverse Typical Atrial Flutter After Mitral Valve Repair via a Superior Transseptal Approach
Sleep‐Disordered Breathing and Sleep Fragmentation in Relation to Atrial Fibrillation Risk: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
Small Discrete Pre‐Potential‐Like Electrogram Recorded by a Lattice‐Tip Catheter at the Initiation of Atrial Fibrillation
Hemodynamic and Metabolic Predictors of Unsuccessful Electrical Cardioversion or Early Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Electrical Cardioversion
Renal Sympathetic Denervation Plus Pulmonary Vein Isolation for Atrial Fibrillation in Patients with Hypertension: A Meta-Analysis of Randomised Controlled Trials
summary: To assess the efficacy and safety of adding adjuvant renal sympathetic denervation (RSDN) to pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). A search of multiple electronic databases was conducted using a comprehensive strategy to identify randomised controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating the impact of RSDN combined with PVI compared with PVI alone in patients with AF and hypertension. The search results were imported to Covidence for article eligibility screening. Six RCTs were included, involving a total of 516 patients. The rate of AF recurrence [RR: 0.58, 95% CI (0.40; 0.82), p = 0.002, I2 = 28%] was significantly lower with RSDN+PVI compared to PVI alone at 12 months, whereas no significant difference was found at 24 months (p = 0.93). RSDN+PVI significantly reduced systolic blood pressure (SBP) at 12 months (MD: -13.41, 95% CI = -15.59; -11.22, p <0.001, I2 = 88%) and diastolic blood pressure (DBP) at 12 months (MD: -4.54, 95% CI -7.66; -1.42, p = 0.004, I2 = 81%) compared to PVI alone. This meta-analysis demonstrated that SBP and DBP, as well as AF recurrence, were lower at 12 months in the PVI plus adjunctive RSDN therapy group than in the PVI-alone group. Key Words: Renal sympathetic denervation, Pulmonary vein isolation, Atrial fibrillation, Hypertension, Catheter ablation, Antiarrhythmic therapy.

AI.tldr: 纳入6项RCT共516例合并高血压的AF患者，RSDN联合PVI较单纯PVI显著降低12个月AF复发（RR 0.58）并使收缩压下降约13.4 mmHg，但24个月复发率无差异。
AI.motivation: 高血压是AF发生和导管消融后复发的重要驱动因素，肾交感神经过度激活被认为参与心房结构重构与心律失常基质形成。在PVI基础上追加肾交感神经去神经（RSDN）能否进一步减少复发、改善血压控制，既往单项研究结果不一致，缺乏针对RCT的汇总证据。
AI.method: 系统评价与荟萃分析。检索多个电子数据库，经Covidence进行文献筛选，纳入比较RSDN+PVI与单纯PVI的随机对照试验（RCT），研究对象为合并高血压的AF患者，共6项RCT、516例。观察终点包括12个月及24个月的AF复发、12个月收缩压（SBP）与舒张压（DBP）变化。效应量以RR（二分类）与MD（连续变量）表示，附95%CI、P值及I²异质性检验；具体检索时限、偏倚风险评估方法及合并模型（固定或随机效应）摘要未报告。
AI.result: 12个月AF复发率在RSDN+PVI组显著低于单纯PVI组：RR 0.58（95%CI 0.40–0.82），p=0.002，I²=28%。24个月复发率两组无显著差异（p=0.93，具体效应量与置信区间摘要未报告）。12个月SBP下降更明显：MD −13.41 mmHg（95%CI −15.59至−11.22），p<0.001，I²=88%；DBP：MD −4.54 mmHg（95%CI −7.66至−1.42），p=0.004，I²=81%。围术期并发症等安全性终点摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 在合并高血压的AF患者中，PVI联合RSDN可降低12个月AF复发风险并改善12个月血压控制，提示肾上腺能抑制对消融后早期复发具有附加价值；但该获益在24个月未能维持，且血压合并结果异质性高（I²达81%–88%）、总体样本量仅516例、安全性数据缺失，尚不足以支持将RSDN作为常规辅助策略，需更大规模、更长随访且统一消融与去神经术式的RCT进一步验证。

title: Clinical value of robot-assisted catheter navigation for cardiac electrophysiology ablation: current evidence and future directions.
summary: The success of catheter ablation depends not only on identification of arrhythmia mechanisms, mapping, and energy strategy, but also on catheter accessibility and stable manipulation. Robot-assisted catheter navigation enables remote control through magnetic fields, robotic sheaths, or mechanical actuation. However, with the development of three-dimensional electroanatomic mapping, low- and zero-fluoroscopy workflows, and newer ablation technologies, the key question has shifted from technical feasibility to whether these systems can overcome practical procedural constraints in specific clinical settings. This review synthesizes the clinical evidence for different robot-assisted catheter navigation technologies. Disease-specific comparative studies and long-term outcome data are derived mainly from robotic magnetic navigation. Current evidence consistently supports reduced conventional X-ray use with robotic navigation; in selected settings involving complex anatomy, abnormal vascular pathways, or limited catheter reachability, available studies show technical feasibility and procedural support, but consistent benefits in procedural efficiency, safety, and long-term patient outcomes have not been demonstrated. Its clinical value depends mainly on whether the dominant procedural limitation lies in catheter navigation and manipulation and is jointly influenced by the compatibility and availability of supporting technologies, the comparator, and center-specific workflow; procedural improvements do not necessarily translate into long-term patient benefit. Future studies should identify patients with a clear catheter-navigation need, distinguish the effect of robotic catheter navigation itself from that of the complete treatment strategy, and further evaluate its actual value for patients, operators, and healthcare systems.

AI.tldr: 该综述认为，机器人辅助导管导航可减少常规X线暴露，但在手术效率、安全性和长期预后上的获益尚未获得一致证据。
AI.motivation: 导管消融成功不仅取决于心律失常机制识别、标测和能量策略，也取决于导管可达性和稳定操作。机器人辅助导管导航可通过磁场、机器人鞘或机械驱动实现遥控；随着三维电解剖标测、低/零透视流程和新型消融技术发展，关键问题已从技术可行性转向其能否在特定临床场景中克服实际手术限制。现有疾病特异性比较研究和长期结局数据主要来自机器人磁导航，证据仍有缺口。
AI.method: 本文为综述，汇总不同机器人辅助导管导航技术的临床证据。研究对象与样本量摘要未报告；纳入场景包括复杂解剖、血管路径异常或导管可达性受限等，比较对象、终点定义和统计方法摘要未报告。关注终点包括常规X线使用、技术可行性/手术支持、手术效率、安全性及长期患者结局。
AI.result: 现有证据一致支持机器人导航可减少常规X线使用；在复杂解剖、血管路径异常或导管可达性受限的特定场景中，研究显示技术可行性和手术支持，但手术效率、安全性和长期患者结局的一致获益尚未证实。摘要未报告效应量、95%CI或P值。其临床价值主要取决于手术的主要限制是否在导管导航与操作，并受配套技术兼容性与可及性、对照策略及中心工作流程共同影响；手术流程改善不一定转化为长期患者获益。
AI.conclusion: 机器人辅助导管导航在减少透视和特定困难解剖中的导航支持方面具有明确价值，但现有证据不足以支持其在手术效率、安全性和长期预后方面的一致获益。电生理实践中应将其用于以导管导航/操作为主要瓶颈的病例，并与配套技术和中心流程整合。未来研究需筛选具有明确导管导航需求的患者，区分机器人导航本身与完整治疗策略的效应，并评估其对患者、术者和医疗系统的实际价值；本综述证据以机器人磁导航为主，缺乏统一对照和长期随机数据。

title: The Lazarus Protocol: Rescue Catheter Ablation of Incessant Ventricular Fibrillation by Purkinje Substrate Denetworking in Critically Ill Patients With Ischemic Cardiomyopathy.
summary: We report a case series of 3 critically ill patients with refractory incessant ventricular fibrillation (VF) who underwent catheter ablation using high-density mapping of the Purkinje system during ongoing VF, combined with targeted Purkinje denetworking and myocardial substrate modification. All patients were supported with advanced mechanical circulatory support, including venoarterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation or venoarterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation with Impella support, and procedures were guided by electroanatomic mapping with multimodality imaging integration. Purkinje potentials and abnormal electrograms within infarcted and border-zone myocardium were targeted, resulting in restoration and maintenance of sinus rhythm with no inducible ventricular arrhythmias after ablation. These findings suggest that, in carefully selected patients, combined Purkinje-targeted ablation and substrate modification may provide a life-saving rescue strategy for otherwise refractory incessant VF.

AI.tldr: 3例合并缺血性心肌病的危重患者，在无休止室颤持续发作期间接受高密度浦肯野系统标测指导的浦肯野网络离断联合心肌基质改良，术后均恢复并维持窦性心律，且不能再诱发室性心律失常。
AI.motivation: 无休止性室颤（VF）在缺血性心肌病患者中致死率极高，抗心律失常药物、深度镇静、机械循环支持及常规导管消融常难以终止发作，临床缺少可挽救生命的处理手段。浦肯野系统在缺血性室颤的触发与维持中起关键作用，但在室颤持续发作、血流动力学崩溃的状态下进行浦肯野标测与离断的经验极为有限，既往文献几乎无此类挽救性策略的系统报道。
AI.method: 单中心病例系列，共3例危重、药物难治性无休止室颤并合并缺血性心肌病的患者。干预措施为：在室颤持续发作期间对浦肯野系统行高密度标测，并在此基础上实施靶向浦肯野网络离断及心肌基质改良（靶点为浦肯野电位及梗死区、边缘区异常电图）；手术在三维电解剖标测与多模态影像融合指导下完成。全部患者均在机械循环支持下手术，包括静脉-动脉体外膜肺氧合（VA-ECMO），或VA-ECMO联合Impella支持。评价终点为窦性心律的恢复与维持以及术后室性心律失常诱发试验结果。摘要未报告患者具体基线特征、标测与消融参数、随访时长及统计方法。
AI.result: 3例患者均完成手术，术后均恢复并维持窦性心律，消融后室性心律失常均不能被诱发。摘要未报告手术时长、消融点数、围术期并发症、机械循环支持时长、随访时间及生存率等数据；作为无对照的病例系列，也未提供效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值。
AI.conclusion: 提示对经过严格筛选的缺血性心肌病危重患者，在机械循环支持及三维电解剖标测与多模态影像指导下，于室颤持续发作中行浦肯野网络离断联合心肌基质改良，可能成为挽救生命的补救性消融策略。但证据仅为3例、无对照组、单中心经验，且高度依赖术者经验、标测技术与机械循环支持条件；其可重复性、安全性（如消融相关并发症与神经功能预后）及对生存率的影响尚需更大样本前瞻性研究验证。

title: Impact of Interelectrode Spacing on Ventricular Tachycardia Substrate Mapping: Insights Into 3-Dimensional Characteristics of the Arrhythmogenic Substrate.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Re-entrant ventricular tachycardia (VT) circuits often involve 3-dimensional activation across the endocardium, epicardium, and mid-myocardium, highlighting the importance of comprehensive substrate assessment. Wider interelectrode spacing may incorporate broader-field electrical components that are less apparent on conventional closely spaced recordings.

OBJECTIVES: This study sought to investigate the electrophysiological impact of interelectrode spacing on substrate mapping and its potential implications for 3-dimensional features of VT substrate.

METHODS: Sixty-eight high-density substrate maps from 35 patients undergoing catheter ablation for scar-related VT were retrospectively analyzed. Closely spaced (2-mm) and widely spaced (8-mm) bipolar electrograms were simultaneously acquired using a decapolar catheter and used to generate closely and widely spaced bipolar electrode maps (CEM and WEM).

RESULTS: Compared with CEM, WEM, which incorporates a greater contribution of far-field components, demonstrated higher bipolar amplitudes, a greater prevalence of multicomponent electrograms, and a lower prevalence of split potentials (all P < 0.01). Lines of block delineated by split potentials on CEM were frequently attenuated or no longer apparent on WEM because the corresponding electrograms appeared fragmented and lacked a distinct split configuration. In an exploratory analysis of 6 VTs with evaluable activation maps, activation gaps were larger with closely than widely spaced bipolar mapping (32.5% vs 20.0%; P = 0.03). In 4 VTs, widely spaced recordings identified diastolic or presystolic far-field potentials not evident with closely spaced recordings.

CONCLUSIONS: Widely spaced bipolar electrograms may provide complementary functional information beyond that obtained with conventional near-field recordings by incorporating broader-field electrical components, thereby offering additional insight into the potential 3-dimensional characteristics of the arrhythmogenic substrate.

AI.tldr: 在瘢痕相关室速的基质标测中，8 mm 宽间距双极电图较 2 mm 窄间距记录振幅更高、多成分电图更多、分裂电位更少，可补充传统近场记录遗漏的远场与三维基质信息。
AI.motivation: 折返性室速环路常涉及心内膜、心外膜与中层心肌的三维激动，需要全面的基质评估；传统窄间距双极记录主要反映局部近场电活动，宽间距电极可能纳入更广范围的电场成分，但电极间距对室速基质标测的电生理影响及其对三维基质特征的提示尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入 35 例接受导管消融的瘢痕相关室速患者，共 68 幅高密度基质标测图。使用十极导管同步采集 2 mm 窄间距与 8 mm 宽间距双极电图，分别构建窄间距双极电极图（CEM）与宽间距双极电极图（WEM），比较双极振幅、多成分电图、分裂电位等指标；并对 6 例可评估激动图的室速作探索性分析，比较激动缺口比例及宽间距记录识别远场电位的能力。
AI.result: 与 CEM 相比，WEM 因纳入更多远场成分，双极振幅更高、多成分电图比例更高、分裂电位比例更低（均 P < 0.01）。CEM 上由分裂电位勾画的阻滞线在 WEM 上常被削弱或不再显现，相应电图表现为碎裂而缺乏明确的分裂形态。探索性分析中，窄间距双极标测的激动缺口大于宽间距标测（32.5% vs 20.0%；P = 0.03）；4 例室速中宽间距记录识别出窄间距记录未能显示的舒张期或收缩前期远场电位。摘要未报告振幅、各电图比例的具体数值及置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 宽间距双极电图通过纳入更广范围的电场成分，可提供超越常规近场记录的功能学信息，有助于认识致心律失常基质的三维特征，可能优化瘢痕相关室速的基质标测与消融策略。但本研究为小样本回顾性分析，三维特征的探索性结果仅基于少数室速，宽间距标测能否改善消融终点与临床预后尚需前瞻性验证。

title: Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy for VT in Chagas Cardiomyopathy: A Prospective Phase I/II Pilot Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) is a novel noninvasive therapy for ventricular tachycardia (VT), but its role in Chagas cardiomyopathy remains unexplored.

OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to evaluate the safety and preliminary efficacy of SBRT for refractory VT in patients with chronic Chagas cardiomyopathy.

METHODS: We prospectively enrolled patients with Chagas cardiomyopathy and refractory VT who had failed or were ineligible for catheter ablation. A single 25-Gy fraction of SBRT was delivered to an arrhythmogenic substrate identified by multimodality imaging. The primary outcomes were a reduction in VT burden and treatment-related adverse events.

RESULTS: Eleven patients (age: 64.9 ± 6.7 years; LVEF: 31.6 ± 9.8%) with implantable cardioverter-defibrillators, 9 of whom had prior failed ablations, underwent SBRT. The median internal target volume was 27.3 cm3, and the planning target volume was 91.1 cm3. During a median follow-up of 160 days, VT recurred in 10 patients. The median time to recurrence after a 6-week blanking period was 79 days (IQR: 51.5-167). The patient without recurrence died of noncardiac causes 22 days after SBRT. Comparing the 12 months after SBRT with the 6 months before SBRT, there was a statistically significant reduction in the burden of VT episodes (P = 0.040), antitachycardia pacing therapies (P = 0.012), and combined antitachycardia pacing/shocks (P = 0.022), although isolated implantable cardioverter-defibrillator shocks were not statistically significantly reduced. The 12-month overall survival was 45.5%, and no severe treatment-related adverse events were reported.

CONCLUSIONS: SBRT is a feasible approach for refractory VT in Chagas cardiomyopathy. Despite a high rate of VT recurrence, SBRT statistically significantly reduced the burden of ventricular arrhythmia, warranting further investigation.

AI.tldr: 在11例难治性室性心动过速（VT）的慢性恰加斯心肌病患者中，单次25 Gy立体定向体部放射治疗（SBRT）虽复发率高，但显著降低了VT发作与抗心动过速起搏（ATP）治疗负荷，且未报告严重治疗相关不良事件。
AI.motivation: SBRT是治疗VT的新型无创手段，但既往证据集中于缺血性及非缺血性心肌病，在恰加斯心肌病这一心律失常负荷高、导管消融失败率较高的特殊人群中尚属空白。本研究旨在评估SBRT用于该类患者难治性VT的安全性及初步疗效，填补这一证据缺口。
AI.method: 前瞻性单臂I/II期 pilot 研究，连续纳入慢性恰加斯心肌病合并难治性VT、既往导管消融失败或不适合消融的患者，共11例（年龄64.9±6.7岁，LVEF 31.6±9.8%，均植入ICD，其中9例既往消融失败）。经多模态影像识别致心律失常基质后，给予单次25 Gy SBRT；中位内靶体积27.3 cm³，计划靶体积91.1 cm³。主要终点为VT负荷下降及治疗相关不良事件；采用SBRT后12个月与术前6个月的自身前后比较，具体统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 中位随访160天，10例（10/11）VT复发；6周空白期后中位复发时间79天（IQR 51.5–167）。唯一未复发者于SBRT后22天死于非心脏原因。与术前6个月相比，SBRT后12个月的VT发作负荷（P=0.040）、ATP治疗（P=0.012）及ATP/电击复合终点（P=0.022）均显著降低，但单纯ICD电击未见统计学显著减少。12个月总生存率45.5%，未报告严重治疗相关不良事件。
AI.conclusion: 对于恰加斯心肌病合并难治性VT且消融失败或不适合消融的患者，单次25 Gy SBRT在技术上可行，可显著减少VT发作及ATP治疗负荷，安全性方面未观察到严重治疗相关不良事件。但VT复发率仍高（10/11），且12个月总生存率仅45.5%，提示该人群整体预后差；本研究样本量小、为单臂自身对照、随访时间短且缺少对照组的混杂因素影响，这些均限制结论强度，尚需更大规模的对照研究验证其对硬终点（ICD电击、住院、生存）的作用。

title: Mortality involving non-rheumatic valvular heart disease and atrial fibrillation in the United States: Long-term trends and implications
summary: Non-Rheumatic valvular heart disease (NRVHD) and atrial fibrillation (AF) are major contributors to cardiovascular mortality in the U.S. Their coexistence increases the risk of stroke, heart failure, and death.This study examines national trends in deaths involving both NRVHD and AF in the United States from 1999 to 2023. Centers for disease control and prevention - Wide-Ranging Online Data for Epidemiologic Research data (1999-2023) were analyzed for adults with AF (I48) and NRVHD (I34-I36) as contributing causes of death. Age-adjusted mortality rates (AAMRs) were calculated per 100,000 population. Joinpoint regression analysis was used to determine average and annual percent change (AAPC) and annual percent change. From 1999 to 2023, a total of 141,846 deaths in the U.S. involved both AF and NRVHD. The AAMR increased from 2.98 in 1999 to 7.30 in 2023 (AAPC: 4.17; P < .001). Males had higher overall AAMR (5.31) (AAPC: 4.73) than females (4.02) (AAPC: 3.58). Non-hispanic Whites had the highest overall AAMR (5.17) while Hispanics had an AAMR of (1.88). Regionally, West had the highest overall AAMR (5.73), followed by the Northeast (4.81), the Midwest (4.79), and then the South (3.48). Majority of the deaths occurred in inpatient medical facilities (49,170 deaths, 35.0%). The age group 65 + showed the highest mortality (crude mortality rate: 11.93). Rural areas had higher overall AAMR (4.36) compared to urban areas (4.10). Deaths involving both AF and NRVHD increased from 1999 to 2023, with greater burden among older adults, males, rural areas, the West region, and non-Hispanic White population.

AI.tldr: 1999—2023年美国同时涉及非风湿性瓣膜性心脏病与房颤的死亡从141,846例累计记录中年龄标化死亡率由2.98升至7.30/10万（AAPC 4.17，P<.001），负担集中于男性、65岁以上、农村及西部人群。
AI.motivation: 非风湿性瓣膜性心脏病（NRVHD）与房颤（AF）共存可显著增加卒中、心力衰竭与死亡风险，但既往证据多为单病种或短期分析，缺乏对二者共同致死负担的长期全国性趋势描述，难以指导筛查、抗凝与瓣膜干预策略的资源配置。
AI.method: 基于美国CDC WONDER数据库（1999—2023）的全国死亡证明数据回顾性分析；纳入以AF（ICD编码I48）与NRVHD（I34—I36）作为死亡原因或促死因素的成人死亡记录；计算每10万人口的年龄标化死亡率（AAMR），采用Joinpoint回归模型估算平均年度变化百分比（AAPC）与年度变化百分比，并按性别、种族、地区、城乡、死亡地点及年龄组分层；摘要未报告具体的协变量校正或敏感性分析方法。
AI.result: 共纳入141,846例同时涉及AF与NRVHD的死亡。AAMR由1999年的2.98升至2023年的7.30（AAPC 4.17，P<.001）。男性总体AAMR 5.31（AAPC 4.73）高于女性4.02（AAPC 3.58）。非西班牙裔白人AAMR最高（5.17），西班牙裔最低（1.88）。地区上西部最高（5.73），其后依次为东北部（4.81）、中西部（4.79）与南部（3.48）。49,170例（35.0%）死亡发生在住院医疗机构。65岁以上年龄组粗死亡负担最高（粗死亡率11.93）。农村地区AAMR（4.36）高于城市（4.10）。各分层AAPC的95%置信区间摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 过去25年美国AF合并NRVHD相关死亡呈持续上升趋势，且存在明显的性别、种族、地域与城乡差异，提示需在高负担人群（老年、男性、农村、西部及非西班牙裔白人）中加强房颤筛查、卒中预防抗凝管理与瓣膜病早期干预。局限性在于研究基于死亡证明编码，可能存在AF与瓣膜病因的误分类、漏报及编码习惯随时间变化的影响，且缺乏个体水平临床变量，无法评估抗凝、导管消融或瓣膜介入等治疗对趋势的作用。

title: Early Catheter Ablation for Patients With Atrial Fibrillation and a Stroke History: A Target Trial Emulation Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a major contributor to ischemic stroke, yet evidence on whether catheter ablation improves outcomes in patients with AF and a history of stroke remains limited. We emulated a target trial using observational data to estimate the effect of early catheter ablation vs medical therapy on clinical outcomes in this high-risk population.

METHODS: We retrospectively included patients aged 18-85 years with AF and a history of ischemic stroke from 6 Chinese centers between January 2019 and December 2024. The primary outcome was major adverse cardiovascular events (MACEs). Secondary outcomes included all-cause rehospitalization, cardiovascular rehospitalization, all-cause death, and functional and cognitive outcomes assessed by modified Rankin Scale (mRS) and post hoc AD8 scores. A cloning-censoring-weighting approach was used to emulate a target trial comparing early ablation (within a 1-year grace period) and medical therapy in time-dependent outcomes, using weighted Kaplan-Meier curves. Restricted mean survival time (RMST) was used when the proportional hazards assumption was violated. mRS and AD8 were assessed after propensity score matching.

RESULTS: A total of 431 patients were included (median age, 70 years; 37% female), of whom 207 underwent early catheter ablation. The median follow-up was 3.0 years. At 36 months, early ablation was associated with a gain of 1.54 MACE-free months (95% CI 0.40-2.85; p = 0.016) and an absolute risk reduction of 11.17% (95% CI 5.81%-17.36%; p < 0.001). Cardiovascular rehospitalization showed a higher 36-month event-free survival rate in the ablation group (absolute difference 11.98%; 95% CI 2.26%-21.44%; p = 0.018). In the matched cohort (n = 250), ablation was associated with better mRS scores (adjusted odds ratio 0.31; 95% CI 0.19-0.51; p < 0.001) and, in a post hoc cognitive assessment using AD8, lower odds of cognitive impairment (adjusted odds ratio 0.42; 95% CI 0.24-0.72; p = 0.002).

DISCUSSION: In this target trial emulation analysis, catheter ablation was associated with a modestly lower long-term risk of MACE in patients with AF and a stroke history. Secondary analyses suggested exploratory associations between ablation and lower long-term cardiovascular rehospitalization, and better neurologic and cognitive outcomes. Major limitations include the retrospective design and potential residual confounding. Randomized trials with larger sample sizes are warranted.

CLASSIFICATION OF EVIDENCE: This study provides Class III evidence that early catheter ablation in adult patients with AF and a history of ischemic stroke decreases the risk of MACEs compared with guideline-directed medical therapy.

AI.tldr: 431例合并缺血性卒中史的AF患者目标试验模拟显示，早期导管消融较药物治疗36个月MACE绝对风险降低11.17%、无事件时间增加1.54个月，并与更优的mRS和AD8评分相关。
AI.motivation: AF是缺血性卒中的重要病因，但对此类已发生卒中的高危人群，导管消融能否改善硬终点（MACE、再住院、死亡）及神经功能与认知预后，既往证据十分有限，指南推荐亦缺乏针对性数据。研究拟在真实世界人群中估计早期消融相较药物治疗的效应。
AI.method: 回顾性队列＋目标试验模拟（target trial emulation），纳入2019年1月至2024年12月6家中国中心、18–85岁合并缺血性卒中史的AF患者431例（中位年龄70岁，女性37%），其中207例接受早期导管消融（1年宽限期内）。主要终点为MACE；次要终点包括全因再住院、心血管再住院、全因死亡，以及mRS评分与事后AD8认知评分。采用克隆-删失-加权（cloning-censoring-weighting）方法及加权Kaplan-Meier曲线处理时间依赖结局，违反比例风险假设时使用限制性平均生存时间（RMST）；mRS与AD8在倾向性评分匹配后评估。中位随访3.0年。
AI.result: 36个月时，早期消融组MACE无事件时间增加1.54个月（95%CI 0.40–2.85；P=0.016），绝对风险降低11.17%（95%CI 5.81%–17.36%；P<0.001）。心血管再住院36个月无事件生存率在消融组更高，绝对差11.98%（95%CI 2.26%–21.44%；P=0.018）。匹配队列（n=250）中，消融与更佳mRS评分相关（校正OR 0.31；95%CI 0.19–0.51；P<0.001），事后AD8认知评估示认知功能障碍风险更低（校正OR 0.42；95%CI 0.24–0.72；P=0.002）。全因再住院与全因死亡的效应估计摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 在AF合并卒中史患者中，早期导管消融与长期MACE风险中度降低相关，次要分析提示其可能与较低的心血管再住院风险及更好的神经功能与认知结局相关（证据等级Class III）。主要局限为回顾性设计、残余混杂及事件数有限；上述神经认知获益属探索性，需更大样本随机对照试验验证，目前尚不足以据此改变该类患者的消融适应证。

title: Pulmonary Vein Stenosis Following Radiofrequency Catheter Ablation Presenting With Massive Pleural Effusion: A Case Report.
summary: We report a rare case of pulmonary vein stenosis (PVS) presenting with massive pleural effusion 5 months after radiofrequency catheter ablation (RFCA) for atrial fibrillation. A 58-year-old woman developed persistent fever, cough, and left lower lobe consolidation with a large pleural effusion. Initial antibiotic therapy was ineffective. Three-dimensional computed tomography (3D-CT) revealed severe stenosis of the left inferior pulmonary vein. Following balloon angioplasty, both pulmonary consolidation and pleural effusion resolved. Because PVS may present with nonspecific findings and delayed onset, it should be considered in patients with unexplained pulmonary infiltrates or pleural effusion after RFCA.

AI.tldr: 一例 58 岁女性在房颤射频消融术后 5 个月出现以大量胸腔积液为表现的重度左下肺静脉狭窄，经球囊扩张后肺部病变及胸水均消退。
AI.motivation: 肺静脉狭窄是房颤射频消融术后少见但可致严重并发症的迟发并发症，临床表现缺乏特异性，易被误诊为肺炎、肺部感染或肿瘤，导致抗生素治疗无效而延误诊治。既往认识多集中于呼吸困难、咯血等典型表现，以大量胸腔积液为主要表现者罕见，本案例报告旨在对消融术后“不明原因肺部浸润或胸腔积液”这一临床情境中的鉴别诊断提供更多线索。
AI.method: 研究类型为个案报告（case report），样本量为 1 例。对象为 58 岁女性，既往因心房颤动接受射频导管消融（RFCA），术后 5 个月出现持续发热、咳嗽、左下叶实变并伴大量胸腔积液，初始抗生素治疗无效。影像学评估采用三维计算机断层扫描（3D-CT），据此确诊左侧下肺静脉重度狭窄。干预手段为球囊血管成形术。主要观察指标为肺静脉狭窄解除后肺部实变与胸腔积液的转归；随机对照设计与统计检验均不适用，摘要未报告狭窄程度的具体数值、球囊直径、压力及随访时长。
AI.result: 3D-CT 显示左下肺静脉重度狭窄。经球囊血管成形术后，肺部实变与大量胸腔积液均消退。抗生素治疗阶段无效。摘要未报告狭窄直径或压力阶差的具体数值、术后影像复查时间及随访结果。
AI.conclusion: 射频消融术后肺静脉狭窄可迟发起病，且可以大量胸腔积液和肺实变等非特异性表现为主，抗感染治疗无效时应高度警惕。对于 RFCA 后不明原因肺部浸润影或胸腔积液的患者，应尽早行 3D-CT 或肺静脉影像学评估以明确有无 PVS，球囊血管成形术可有效解除狭窄并使继发性肺部改变逆转。局限性为单一病例报告，缺乏发生率、复发率及长期预后数据，结论的外推需更大样本的队列研究验证。

title: Socioeconomic status, healthcare access, and risk of atrial fibrillation: an investigation using the Jackson Heart Study Research Materials.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Rates of atrial fibrillation (AF) are lower in Black compared to White Americans. Socioeconomic disadvantage and reduced healthcare access may contribute to lower observed AF incidence in Black populations due to underdiagnosis and underascertainment. Therefore, we evaluated the association of socioeconomic status and healthcare access with AF incidence in a cohort of Black Americans.

METHODS: 3,240 participants from the Jackson Heart Study, which recruited Black adults from the Jackson metropolitan area in 2000-2004, were followed up through 2016 for incident AF. Socioeconomic position (education and income) and healthcare access (insurance status, difficulty obtaining care, trust in providers, and satisfaction with care) were assessed at baseline. AF was ascertained from study electrocardiograms at baseline and exam 3 and self-reported physician diagnosis at annual follow-up surveys. Multivariable Cox regression was used to estimate hazard ratios (HR) and 95% confidence intervals (CI) for the association between exposure variables and AF incidence adjusting for potential confounders.

RESULTS: During a mean follow-up of 11.5 years, 817 incident AF cases were identified. Higher educational attainment and income were associated with a reduced risk of AF. Compared with participants who had less than a high school education, those who attended trade or vocational school or college had an 18% lower estimated hazard of AF (HR 0.82, 95% CI 0.67, 1.02). Likewise, participants in the highest income category had a 39% lower estimated hazard of AF (HR 0.61, 95% CI 0.47, 0.78) compared with those in the lowest. Easier access to healthcare and greater satisfaction with received healthcare were also associated with lower AF risk.

CONCLUSION: Higher socioeconomic status and better healthcare access were associated with lower risk of AF in a cohort of Black Americans. These findings do not support a simple explanation in which socioeconomic disadvantage and poorer healthcare access lead to lower observed AF incidence through underascertainment within Black adults.

AI.tldr: 在 3,240 名黑人成年人中，较高的教育程度和收入、更好的医疗可及性与就医满意度均与房颤发病风险降低相关，这并不支持“医疗可及性差导致漏诊、从而低估黑人房颤发病率”的假说。
AI.motivation: 美国黑人房颤发生率低于白人，既往解释认为社会经济劣势与医疗可及性下降会造成漏诊和病例发现不足，使黑人人群的房颤发病率被低估；但这一假说缺乏在黑人前瞻性队列中的直接验证，本研究即在全部由黑人组成的队列中检验社会经济地位和医疗可及性与房颤发病的关联。
AI.method: 杰克逊心脏研究（Jackson Heart Study）队列，2000-2004 年在杰克逊大都市区招募黑人成年人 3,240 名，随访至 2016 年。基线评估社会经济地位（教育程度、收入）与医疗可及性（保险状态、就医困难程度、对医疗提供者的信任、就医满意度）。房颤判定依据基线及第 3 次检查的研究心电图，以及年度随访调查中自报的医生诊断。采用多因素 Cox 回归估计风险比（HR）及 95% 置信区间（CI），并校正潜在混杂因素；摘要未报告具体校正变量、随访完整率及失访情况。
AI.result: 平均随访 11.5 年，共识别 817 例新发房颤。与高中以下学历者相比，就读职业学校或大学者的房颤风险估计降低 18%（HR 0.82，95%CI 0.67-1.02）；最高收入组与最低收入组相比降低 39%（HR 0.61，95%CI 0.47-0.78）。就医更便利、对所获医疗服务更满意也与较低的房颤风险相关（摘要未报告对应 HR 与 95%CI）。摘要未报告 P 值，也未报告保险状态、就医困难及信任度的具体效应量。
AI.conclusion: 在该黑人队列中，较高的社会经济地位与更好的医疗可及性和更低的房颤风险相关，其方向与“社会经济劣势、医疗可及性差导致漏诊从而低估房颤负担”的解释相反；若漏诊是主要机制，弱势人群应表现为更低的观测发病率，而非更高。这提示在黑人人群中应加强房颤主动筛查与危险因素管理，而非把低发病率视为真实低风险。局限包括：单地区队列、房颤依赖心电图与自报诊断、暴露仅在基线单次测量、可能存在残余混杂；教育程度这一项的 95%CI 上限为 1.02，因此该结果尚不足以断定关联具有统计学显著性，因果推断仍需进一步验证。

title: Body Roundness Index Trajectories and Incident Left Ventricular Hypertrophy: Results of a Community-Based Study in Korea.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Left ventricular hypertrophy (LVH) constitutes Stage B heart failure and marks elevated risk for atrial fibrillation, stroke, and death. Unlike body mass index, body roundness index (BRI), derived from waist circumference and height, more accurately reflects visceral adiposity. Because existing BRI-LVH evidence is usually cross-sectional, we investigated whether the BRI trajectory can predict incident LVH.

METHODS: Of a total of 2,578 subjects who underwent echocardiographic examinations, we studied 1,764 participants who were free of LVH on echocardiography at baseline (2007-2008, wave 4). BRI trajectory was determined from BRI values measured at four biennial examinations (2001-2008). The outcome was incident LVH on echocardiography during the follow-up (2009-2016, wave 5-8).

RESULTS: The mean age was 53.2±6.3 years, and 828 (46.9%) were women. Latent class mixed models identified 3 sex-specific BRI trajectory classes: stable-low (Class 1), stable-moderate (Class 2), and variable-high BRI (Class 3). Among men, 225 (24.0%), 615 (65.7%), and 96 (10.3%) were classified into these classes, respectively; among women, 319 (38.5%), 356 (43.0%), and 153 (18.5%). Incident LVH, defined as LVH on echocardiography at any of the 4 follow-up examinations conducted during 2009-2016 (wave 5-8), developed in 249 of 936 men (26.6%) and 196 of 828 women (23.7%), and incidence increased across trajectory classes in both sexes (in men, 5.8%, 30.6%, and 50.0%; in women, 7.5%, 32.3%, and 37.3%; both P < 0.001). In the fully adjusted model, compared with Class 1, OR of incident LVH were increased for Class 2 (men; 4.75 [95% CI, 2.33-9.66]; women, 4.53 [2.67-7.68]; both P < 0.001) and for Class 3 (men, 9.28 [3.91-22.02]; women, 4.60 [2.50-8.48]; both P < 0.001).
