title: Progressive conduction system disease preceding hypertrophy in IVS4+919G>A Fabry variant: a population-based electrocardiographic study
summary: Aims The IVS4+919G>A variant is the most prevalent late-onset Fabry variant in East Asian populations, but its electrophysiological trajectory remains incompletely defined.Methods and results From a regional genetic screening programme, 905 IVS4+919G>A carriers were identified among 457 581 patients and matched 1:2 to controls by age and sex. Electrocardiographic (ECG) parameters were compared across decades, and echocardiography correlated structural changes with ECG findings. The cumulative prevalence of IVS4+919G>A was 0.198%. Age-specific prevalence in females was ∼2.5-fold higher than in males (0.11-0.15%), without significant change throughout different age categories. Female carriers demonstrated the catch-up phenomenon after the age of 60. Males exhibited a nine-fold risk of right bundle branch block and pacemaker implantation compared with male controls (right bundle branch block, HR 9.286, 95% CI 5.16-16.70, P < 0.001; pacemaker implantation, HR 9.197, 95% CI 2.88-29.31, P < 0.001), and this precedes the onset of echocardiographic left ventricular hypertrophy. Risk of stroke and atrial fibrillation (HR 1.435, 95% CI 0.69-2.96, P = 0.289) was similar between male carriers and controls. PR interval did not shorten but was prolonged instead. Combining left ventricular hypertrophy with conduction abnormalities, ECG detection achieved 88% sensitivity, exceeding echocardiographic criteria alone (51.5%).Conclusion The IVS4+919G>A variant is characterized by a progressive electrical phenotype dominated by conduction system disease preceding hypertrophy without excess major arrhythmic events. Electrocardiographic surveillance and phenotype-based risk stratification may be more informative than structural assessment alone for identifying individuals at risk of device therapy.Institutional Review Board: CMUH113-REC3-076.

AI.tldr: 在905例IVS4+919G>A法布雷变异携带者中，传导系统病变先于心肌肥厚出现，男性右束支阻滞与起搏器植入风险约为对照的9倍，而房颤与卒中风险未见显著升高。
AI.motivation: IVS4+919G>A是东亚人群最常见的晚发型法布雷病（Fabry）变异，心脏受累常见，但其电生理演变轨迹尚不明确。既往筛查多依赖超声心动图的结构学指标，缺乏基于人群的心电图自然史证据，也不清楚传导异常与左心室肥厚孰先孰后，以及是否伴随房性心律失常和卒中风险增加。
AI.method: 基于区域遗传筛查项目的观察性研究：在457 581例受筛者中识别出905例IVS4+919G>A携带者，按年龄和性别以1:2匹配对照。按十年年龄段比较心电图参数，并将超声心动图结构改变与心电图表现做相关分析。观察终点包括右束支阻滞、起搏器植入、房颤、卒中、PR间期及心电图对受累者的检出灵敏度，效应量以HR及95%CI表示。
AI.result: 该变异累积患病率为0.198%；女性年龄别患病率约为男性的2.5倍（0.11–0.15%），且随年龄段无明显变化，女性携带者在60岁后出现“追赶”现象。男性携带者右束支阻滞风险为男性对照的9倍（HR 9.286，95%CI 5.16–16.70，P<0.001），起搏器植入风险同样约为9倍（HR 9.197，95%CI 2.88–29.31，P<0.001），且均早于超声心动图左心室肥厚的出现；男性携带者与对照的卒中及房颤风险相近（HR 1.435，95%CI 0.69–2.96，P=0.289）。PR间期未缩短，反而延长。将左心室肥厚与传导异常联合判读，心电图检出灵敏度达88%，高于单用超声心动图标准的51.5%。
AI.conclusion: IVS4+919G>A变异呈现以传导系统病变为主导的渐进性电学表型，早于心肌肥厚出现，未见主要心律失常事件增加。提示对携带者应开展心电图随访，并以基于表型的危险分层（而非单纯结构评估）识别可能需起搏器治疗的高危个体；本研究为单区域筛查队列、观察性设计，随访时长及各年龄段心电图具体数值摘要未报告，结论外推需谨慎。

title: Navigating Heart Failure and Atrial Fibrillation Therapy in MELAS.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Mitochondrial encephalomyopathy with lactic acidosis and stroke-like episodes (MELAS) is a mitochondrial DNA disorder in which medications that impair mitochondrial function may worsen disease manifestations. Management of heart failure and arrhythmias in this population is therefore challenging.

CASE SUMMARY: A 54-year-old woman with MELAS presented with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure, atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response, and newly reduced left ventricular ejection fraction. Transesophageal echocardiography demonstrated a left atrial appendage thrombus, precluding immediate cardioversion. In collaboration with medical genetics, rate-control and guideline-directed heart failure therapies were cautiously initiated and titrated. Following anticoagulation, she underwent successful cardioversion and subsequently demonstrated recovery of left ventricular systolic function.

DISCUSSION: This case illustrates the individualized use of conventional cardiovascular therapies in a patient with MELAS and probable arrhythmia-mediated cardiomyopathy. Multidisciplinary assessment, cautious medication titration, and close monitoring allowed effective treatment while minimizing potential mitochondrial toxicity.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGES: Conventional heart failure and atrial fibrillation therapies may be used in selected patients with MELAS after careful assessment of clinical benefit and potential mitochondrial risk. Multidisciplinary collaboration, cautious dose titration, and close monitoring are essential during treatment.

AI.tldr: 54岁MELAS女性患者合并房颤伴快速心室率、左室收缩功能新发下降及左心耳血栓，经多学科协作谨慎滴定心率控制与指南导向心衰治疗、抗凝后成功复律，左室收缩功能恢复。
AI.motivation: MELAS（线粒体脑肌病伴乳酸酸中毒和卒中样发作）是线粒体DNA疾病，凡可能损害线粒体功能的药物均可能加重病情，因此该人群的心衰与心律失常药物治疗非常棘手。既往证据多为零散经验，缺乏关于常规心血管药物在此类患者中安全性与获益的报道，临床决策缺少依据。
AI.method: 为单例病例报告（JACC Case Rep，遗传与基础亚专业）。对象为1例54岁女性MELAS患者，因急性低氧性呼吸衰竭、心房颤动伴快速心室率及新发左室射血分数（LVEF）降低就诊；经食道超声证实左心耳血栓，故未行即刻复律。与医学遗传科协作，谨慎启动并逐步滴定心率控制药物与指南导向心衰治疗，同时抗凝，血栓消解后实施复律，并随访左室收缩功能。摘要未报告统计分析方法和终点量化定义。
AI.result: 抗凝治疗后复律成功，随后左室收缩功能恢复，提示心功能不全可能为心律失常介导性心肌病。摘要未报告具体LVEF数值、心室率、抗凝时长、复律方式（电复律或药物）及随访时间，亦未报告任何效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 在个体化评估临床获益与潜在线粒体毒性风险后，部分MELAS患者可以使用常规心衰与房颤治疗；多学科协作、谨慎的剂量滴定与密切监测是安全实施的关键。局限性为单例个案报道，结果不可外推，且缺乏剂量与疗效的量化数据，尚需更多病例或注册研究验证。

title: Pediatric Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia: Clinical Characteristics, Genetic Spectrum, and Outcomes in a Multicenter Cohort.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT) is a rare inherited arrhythmia with a high risk of life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias in childhood.

OBJECTIVES: This study sought to characterize pediatric CPVT and evaluate contemporary therapeutic outcomes, including left cardiac sympathetic denervation (LCSD) and bilateral cardiac sympathetic denervation (BCSD).

METHODS: This retrospective multicenter study included 92 pediatric patients with CPVT from 3 tertiary centers in Türkiye between 2012 and 2025. Arrhythmic events included aborted cardiac arrest, sudden cardiac death, appropriate implantable cardioverter-defibrillator shocks, arrhythmic syncope, and ventricular tachycardia. Paired preprocedural and postprocedural event rates were compared in patients with an adequate preprocedural observation period.

RESULTS: Median age at symptom onset was 9.25 years (IQR: 5.88-12.0), and median age at diagnosis was 11.6 years (IQR: 8.64-14.41). Among 87 genetically tested patients, 74 (85.1%) had a pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant; ryanodine receptor 2 and calsequestrin 2 variants were identified in 41 (47.1%) and 24 (27.6%), respectively. Fifty patients underwent sympathetic denervation (LCSD, n = 25; BCSD, n = 25). In the paired cohort (n = 35), median arrhythmic event rate decreased from 3.20 events/year (IQR: 1.74-8.76) before LCSD/BCSD to 0.00 events/year (IQR: 0.00-1.35) during the first 2 postprocedural years (P < 0.001). First 2-year event rates did not differ significantly between procedures. Seven patients died; documented treatment nonadherence was present in all.

CONCLUSIONS: LCSD/BCSD was associated with a substantial reduction in arrhythmic burden, but observational treatment allocation and center-specific management preclude conclusions regarding comparative effectiveness. Sustained treatment adherence remains essential.

AI.tldr: 土耳其三中心92例儿童CPVT队列显示，交感神经去支配术使配对35例年事件率由3.20次降至0.00次，7例死亡者均存在治疗不依从。
AI.motivation: 儿茶酚胺敏感性多形性室性心动过速（CPVT）是罕见遗传性心律失常，儿童期即有较高的致死性室性心律失常风险。既往证据多来自单中心、小样本研究，对现代治疗策略（尤其是左侧心脏交感神经去支配术 LCSD 与双侧心脏交感神经去支配术 BCSD）在儿童人群中的疗效及两者比较，数据仍有限。
AI.method: 回顾性多中心队列研究，纳入2012—2025年土耳其3家三级中心的92例儿童CPVT患者。心律失常事件定义为复苏成功的心脏骤停、心源性猝死、ICD恰当放电、心律失常性晕厥及室性心动过速。对术前观察期充分的患者进行术前与术后事件率的配对比较，并分析遗传检测结果与结局；摘要未报告具体统计检验方法细节。
AI.result: 症状发作中位年龄9.25岁（IQR 5.88–12.0），诊断中位年龄11.6岁（IQR 8.64–14.41）。87例接受基因检测，74例（85.1%）携带致病或可能致病变异，其中 RYR2 41例（47.1%）、CASQ2 24例（27.6%）。50例接受交感神经去支配术（LCSD 25例、BCSD 25例）。配对队列（n=35）的年心律失常事件率由术前3.20次/年（IQR 1.74–8.76）降至术后前2年的0.00次/年（IQR 0.00–1.35），P<0.001；LCSD与BCSD术后2年事件率未见显著差异。共7例死亡，均有记录在案的治疗不依从。
AI.conclusion: LCSD/BCSD与儿童CPVT患者心律失常负荷的显著下降相关，但治疗分配为观察性、且各中心管理策略不同，故不能就两种术式的相对疗效得出结论；持续的治疗依从性是改善预后的关键。结果支持在药物控制不佳的儿童CPVT中考虑交感神经去支配术，仍需前瞻性对照研究验证。

title: Pathogenic variants in myoferlin ( MYOF) cause arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy.
summary:
Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy (ACM) is an inherited disease characterized by fibrofatty remodeling and sudden cardiac death linked to desmosomal dysfunction. Yet, 40% of cases remain genetically unexplained, and non-desmosomal mutations offer insight into ACM pathophysiology. Myoferlin (MYOF), a calcium (Ca²⁺)-binding protein in cardiomyocytes, is linked to cardiomyopathy, but its mechanism remains unknown. Whole-exome sequencing identified a heterozygous MYOF missense variant (p.G1654S) in an ACM family; we subsequently found three unrelated p.G1654S cases. We hypothesized that MYOF deficiency promotes Ca²⁺ handling deficits and arrhythmogenesis in ACM. In patient iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes, MYOF p.G1654S protein dimerized with wild-type protein and underwent accelerated lysosomal degradation, showed disrupted Ca²⁺ handling, and displayed increased arrhythmia burden - all rescued by genomic correction. MYOF interacted with CaV1.2, and verapamil pharmacologically rescued arrhythmias. Heterozygous Myof knockout mice showed systolic dysfunction and fibrosis. These findings establish MYOF as a causative ACM gene and therapeutic target that mediates arrhythmogenesis by disrupting MYOF-CaV1.2.

ONE SENTENCE SUMMARY: MYOF deficiency disrupts MYOF-CaV1.2 interaction and calcium handling, causing arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy.

AI.tldr: 全外显子测序在一个 ACM 家系及 3 例无亲缘关系患者中检出 MYOF 杂合错义变异 p.G1654S；该变异通过加速溶酶体降解、破坏 MYOF-CaV1.2 互作与钙处理而致心律失常，维拉帕米可药物挽救。
AI.motivation: 致心律失常性心肌病（ACM）以纤维脂肪替代和心源性猝死为特征，既往证据主要指向桥粒功能障碍；但约 40% 病例仍缺乏基因解释，非桥粒基因的发现有助于阐明 ACM 的病理生理机制。Myoferlin（MYOF）是心肌细胞内的钙结合蛋白，既往已被提示与心肌病相关，但致病机制不明，也未被确立为 ACM 的致病基因。
AI.method: 研究为遗传学与功能学结合的设计。通过全外显子测序，在一个 ACM 家系中鉴定出 MYOF 杂合错义变异 p.G1654S，随后又发现 3 例无亲缘关系的 p.G1654S 携带者。功能验证采用患者 iPSC 来源心肌细胞，比较突变与野生型蛋白的二聚化与溶酶体降解、钙处理及心律失常负荷，并进行基因组校正以验证因果关系；同时检测 MYOF 与 CaV1.2 的相互作用及维拉帕米的药物干预效果；此外，在杂合 Myof 敲除小鼠中评估收缩功能与纤维化。摘要未报告样本量细节、终点定义及具体统计方法。
AI.result: 在患者 iPSC 来源心肌细胞中，MYOF p.G1654S 蛋白与野生型蛋白形成二聚体，并发生加速的溶酶体降解；细胞表现出钙处理紊乱和心律失常负荷增加，上述表型均可被基因组校正所逆转。机制上，MYOF 与 CaV1.2 相互作用，维拉帕米可药物性挽救心律失常。杂合 Myof 敲除小鼠出现收缩功能减退与纤维化。摘要未报告效应量与 95%CI、P 值等具体统计数值。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将 MYOF 确立为 ACM 的致病基因，并提示其通过破坏 MYOF-CaV1.2 互作与钙处理导致心律失常发生，钙通道阻滞剂（维拉帕米）为潜在的治疗切入点。对电生理实践的意义在于：对于桥粒基因阴性、目前约 40% 基因未明的 ACM 家系，可考虑纳入 MYOF 检测，并为基因型导向治疗提供线索。局限性在于摘要未披露样本量、统计结果及人源证据的代表性，机制与疗效仍需更大规模队列与体内研究验证。

title: Contemporary use of oesophageal temperature probes during left atrial ablation: results from an EHRA Scientific Initiatives Committee survey
Non-invasive assessment of left atrial activation using lead V8 during Bachmann bundle pacing
summary: Aims Bachmann bundle pacing (BBP) improves atrial synchrony by advancing LA activation, but quantifying inter-atrial synchronization remains challenging. This study evaluated whether lead V8 reflects posterolateral LA activation time and whether lead V8 can be used to assess the effect of BBP on LA activation.Methods and results Consecutive patients undergoing an electrophysiology study and ablation (Cohort 1) or BBP lead implantation (Cohort 2) were prospectively enrolled. Surface ECGs were recorded with the V5 electrode repositioned to the V8 location (2 cm below the inferior left scapula). LA activation was determined using the steepest negative downslope of the P-wave (NDAT-P-V8). Iso-V8 was defined as the time from P-wave onset to first positive deflection in lead V8. In Cohort 1, a coronary sinus (CS) catheter invasively determined activation timing at the posterolateral LA (mitral isthmus region). In Cohort 2, NDAT-P-V8 and iso-V8 were used to assess the effect of BBP on LA activation. In Cohort 1 (n = 50), NDAT-P-V8 strongly correlated with the latest CS activation (r = 0.94, P < 0.001). In Cohort 2 (n = 50), lead V8 facilitated intra-procedural assessment of LA activation. IAB was corrected in 20/23 (87%), accompanied by shortening of NDAT-P-V8 (from 120 ± 25 ms to 82 ± 17 ms, P < 0.001) and iso-V8 (from 51 ± 22 ms to 18 ± 17 ms, P < 0.001), consistent with earlier LA activation.Conclusion NDAT-P-V8 closely reflects the invasively determined timing of the posterolateral LA activation and provides a simple non-invasive marker to assess the effect of BBP on LA activation. Lead V8 may therefore help to assess and optimize atrial activation with BBP.

AI.tldr: 在两组各50例患者中，V8导联衍生的NDAT-P-V8与冠状窦导管测得的左房后侧壁最晚激动时间强相关（r=0.94），并可无创显示Bachmann束起搏后左房激动提前。
AI.motivation: Bachmann束起搏（BBP）可通过提前左房激动改善心房同步性，但如何量化房间同步及评估BBP对左房激动的效果仍缺乏简便的无创指标。本研究旨在验证V8导联是否反映左房后侧壁激动时间，并用于评估BBP的急性电生理效应。
AI.method: 前瞻性纳入连续接受电生理检查及消融（队列1）或BBP导线植入（队列2）的患者。将体表心电图V5电极移至V8位置（左肩胛下角下2 cm）记录。以P波最陡负向下降支确定NDAT-P-V8，以P波起点至V8首个正向偏转确定iso-V8。队列1（n=50）用冠状窦导管侵入性测定左房后侧壁（二尖瓣峡部区域）激动时间；队列2（n=50）用上述指标评估BBP对左房激动的效果。主要观察指标为NDAT-P-V8与侵入性最晚激动时间的相关性及BBP前后指标变化；摘要未报告详细统计方法。
AI.result: 队列1（n=50）中，NDAT-P-V8与冠状窦记录的最晚激动时间强相关（r=0.94，P<0.001）。队列2（n=50）中，V8导联便于术中评估左房激动；23例中20例（87%）IAB得到纠正，NDAT-P-V8由120±25 ms缩短至82±17 ms（P<0.001），iso-V8由51±22 ms缩短至18±17 ms（P<0.001），提示左房激动提前。摘要未报告95%CI及临床终点。
AI.conclusion: NDAT-P-V8能较准确反映侵入性测定的左房后侧壁激动时间，是评估BBP对左房激动影响的简便无创指标，可能有助于术中评估和优化BBP的心房激动。局限性在于摘要未报告重复性、盲法及临床硬终点，样本量有限，结论需进一步验证。

title: Retrograde Right Bundle Branch Block in Tachycardia Uncovering AVRT Using a Right-Sided Accessory Pathway.
Multi-Tier Validation of a Single-Lead Wearable ECG Signal-Processing Pipeline: Clinical Comparison and Algorithmic Benchmarking on Public Expert-Annotated Databases.
summary: Wearable single-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) devices are increasingly used for out-of-clinic rhythm monitoring, but the rigour with which their signal-processing pipelines are validated varies widely across the literature, with most published reports relying on either a single clinical comparison or a single algorithmic benchmark. We propose and apply a multi-tier validation methodology-combining clinical reference comparison, expert-annotated database benchmarking, and a deliberate morphological stress-test-and demonstrate it on the SmartGuard single-lead wearable ECG device and its signal-processing pipeline. The three tiers comprise (i) a within-subject clinical comparison in 31 healthy adult volunteers against a Bionet Cardio 7 limb-lead Lead I reference with cardiologist-confirmed measurements (a two-electrode limb configuration approximating Lead I, not a full diagnostic 12-lead ECG), (ii) algorithmic benchmarking on the Lobachevsky University ECG Database (LUDB, 200 records, expert annotations), and (iii) a robustness stress-test on the QT Database (QTDB, 103 records, hybrid expert annotations). The pipeline integrates discrete wavelet transform-based PQRST delineation with a derivative-based QRS-width refinement, a tangent-method T-wave end estimator, and median-absolute-deviation robust averaging. In the clinical tier, mean within-subject biases were negligible for heart rate, QT, QTc and RR (all p > 0.6) and borderline for QRS duration (+7.3 ms, p = 0.066), with a systematic R-wave amplitude underestimation (-0.15 mV, p < 0.0001). On LUDB, heart-rate and RR-interval agreement were excellent (Pearson r > 0.95) and QRS duration good (r = 0.73, MAE 13.8 ms). On QTDB, performance degraded in line with the increased morphological heterogeneity of the dataset, particularly for QT-related metrics. Despite this minimal mean bias at the population level, individual-record QT and QTc errors showed high dispersion, precluding accurate clinical QT interpretation from single wearable traces in individual patients. Moreover, the resting, healthy-adult design of the clinical tier means its findings cannot be extrapolated to arrhythmic conditions or exercising states. The protocol is described in sufficient detail to serve as a template for evaluating other wearable single-lead ECG devices.

AI.tldr: 在31名健康成人中，SmartGuard单导联可穿戴ECG信号处理流程与近似Lead I参考相比，心率、QT、QTc、RR的偏倚可忽略，QRS偏宽7.3 ms，但个体层面QT/QTc误差离散度大，不足以据此对单个患者做QT判读。
AI.motivation: 单导联可穿戴ECG设备已广泛用于院外节律监测，但文献中对其信号处理流程的验证严谨程度差异很大，多数研究只做单一临床对照或单一算法数据库基准，缺乏兼顾临床一致性、专家标注数据库性能和形态学鲁棒性的多层级验证框架，临床医生难以判断该类设备的测量值可否直接用于决策。
AI.method: 方法学研究：提出并演示三级验证方案，并应用于SmartGuard单导联可穿戴ECG设备及其信号处理流程。第一级为自身对照临床比较，纳入31名健康成人志愿者，以Bionet Cardio 7肢体导联（近似Lead I，非完整12导联诊断ECG）为参考，测量值经心内科医师确认；第二级为算法基准测试，使用Lobachevsky大学ECG数据库（LUDB，200条记录，专家标注）；第三级为形态学鲁棒性压力测试，使用QT数据库（QTDB，103条记录，混合专家标注）。流程整合离散小波变换的PQRST分割、基于导数的QRS宽度细化、切线法T波终点估计和基于中位绝对差的稳健平均。统计方法为自身对照偏倚检验（报告P值）、Pearson相关与平均绝对误差（MAE）。
AI.result: 临床层面，心率、QT、QTc、RR的平均自身对照偏倚可忽略（均P > 0.6）；QRS时限处于临界（+7.3 ms，P = 0.066）；R波振幅存在系统性低估（-0.15 mV，P < 0.0001）。LUDB层面，心率与RR间期一致性极佳（Pearson r > 0.95），QRS时限一致性良好（r = 0.73，MAE 13.8 ms）。QTDB层面性能随数据集形态学异质性升高而下降，以QT相关指标尤为明显。尽管人群平均偏倚很小，单个记录的QT与QTc误差离散度很大。
AI.conclusion: 该流程在群体层面偏倚很小，但在单个患者层面QT/QTc误差离散度过大，因此不能用于从单导联可穿戴记录进行临床QT解读；临床验证部分采用静息健康成人，结论不能外推至心律失常状态或运动状态。研究详细描述了该三级方案，可作为评估其他单导联可穿戴ECG设备的验证模板，也提示此类设备的QT类指标需在目标人群中另行验证后方可用于临床。

title: Same-Day Discharge After Cardiac Device Generator Replacement: Safety and Patient Acceptability.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Same-day discharge after cardiac implantable electronic device generator replacement may reduce hospital resource use, but evidence regarding its safety and patient acceptability remains limited. We evaluated the feasibility, safety, and patient-reported acceptability of a day-surgery pathway for isolated generator replacement.

METHODS: We conducted a multicenter retrospective observational study of consecutive adults undergoing isolated cardiac implantable electronic device generator replacement between February 2017 and October 2024. Procedures requiring lead revision, upgrade, extraction, or repositioning were excluded. Patients were managed either through a day-surgery pathway with same-day discharge or through an ordinary-setting pathway. The primary endpoint was device-related infection within 365 days. Secondary outcomes included pocket hematoma, patient preference, and recalled preprocedural anxiety assessed using the Amsterdam Preoperative Anxiety and Information Scale (APAIS) and the Anaesthesia and Surgery-dependent Preoperative Anxiety (ASPA) scale, administered during follow-up after the procedure. A hypothetical projection of bed-day cost savings was also performed.

RESULTS: A total of 416 procedures were analyzed: 216 in the day-surgery group and 200 in the ordinary-setting group. Within 365 days, device-related infection occurred in 4 patients in the day-surgery group and 5 in the ordinary-setting group (1.9% vs. 2.5%; p = 0.743). One pocket hematoma occurred in the day-surgery group and was managed conservatively without subsequent infection. Preference for day surgery was reported by 93.8% of evaluable patients in the day-surgery group and 76.0% in the ordinary-setting group (p < 0.001). Recalled preprocedural APAIS and ASPA scores were significantly lower in the day-surgery group. Using published Italian hospital micro-costing data as an illustrative benchmark, the 216 day-surgery procedures corresponded to a hypothetical reduction in hospital resource consumption of approximately €159,808.

CONCLUSIONS: Same-day discharge after isolated generator replacement was feasible and well accepted and was not associated with a detectable increase in device-related infection within 365 days. Recalled preprocedural anxiety scores were lower among patients managed through the day-surgery pathway, although these assessments were obtained retrospectively during follow-up. Same-day discharge may represent a resource-saving organizational pathway for selected patients, but its economic impact requires assessment in a formal health-economic analysis.

AI.tldr: 多中心回顾性研究纳入416例CIED发生器单独更换患者，日间手术当日出院组365天内器件相关感染率为1.9%，与常规住院组的2.5%无显著差异，且93.8%的患者偏好日间手术。
AI.motivation: CIED发生器更换数量逐年增加，常规住院观察占用大量床位资源；既往关于当日出院安全性的证据多集中于首次植入或包含导线操作的人群，针对“仅更换发生器”这一低风险术式的日间手术路径的安全性数据与患者主观接受度证据仍然有限，尤其缺乏感染与术前焦虑相关指标。
AI.method: 多中心回顾性观察性研究，连续纳入2017年2月至2024年10月接受CIED发生器单独更换的成人患者，排除需导线修整、升级、拔除或复位的病例。按管理路径分为日间手术当日出院组（216例）与常规住院组（200例）。主要终点为365天内器件相关感染；次要终点包括囊袋血肿、患者偏好，以及随访时回顾性评估的术前焦虑（APAIS量表与ASPA量表），并基于已发表的意大利医院微观成本数据做床位日费用的假设性推算。
AI.result: 共分析416例手术。365天内器件相关感染日间组4例、常规组5例（1.9% vs 2.5%，p=0.743）。日间组发生1例囊袋血肿，保守处理且未继发感染。偏好日间手术者在日间组可评估患者中占93.8%，常规组为76.0%（p<0.001）。日间组的回顾性APAIS与ASPA术前焦虑评分显著低于常规组。以已发表的意大利医院微观成本数据为参照，216例日间手术对应假设性医院资源消耗减少约159,808欧元。
AI.conclusion: 对于经选择的CIED发生器单独更换患者，当日出院路径可行、接受度高，且未观察到365天内器件相关感染的增加；日间路径患者的回顾性术前焦虑评分更低，但该评估为术后随访时回顾性采集，存在回忆偏倚。该路径可能降低资源消耗，但成本节约为假设性推算，尚需正式的卫生经济学评价验证，并需前瞻性研究确认其安全性。
